title: Vợ Tào Khang
style: Photorealistic live-action Vietnamese family melodrama film set in Hà Nội today; warm natural grade with soft golden kitchen light, muted old-quarter ochres, cool blue-grey dawn and rain, glossy cold tones for the wealthy world, natural skin texture, subtle 35mm film grain, shallow depth of field.
lighting: Naturalistic soft lighting: warm tungsten and charcoal-stove glow at home, cool grey-blue dawn light with yellow streetlamps on the old-quarter pavement, crisp cold daylight in the glass office and luxury apartment, wet neon reflections on rainy nights.

narrator.voice: Vietnamese woman about 50, strictly standard Hà Nội Northern accent (giọng chuẩn Hà Nội Bắc Bộ, never Southern accent) with clear six tones, warm low alto with a slight husk, fast fluent heartfelt family-drama storytelling in one continuous breath, every word spoken once and clearly, no stutter, no repeated words

@Thu.name: Thu
@Thu.anchor: Thu, 34, hardworking wife who sells sticky rice at dawn; slim, lightly sun-tanned, long black hair in a low loose bun, gentle tired eyes, no makeup, work-roughened hands; faded light-blue cotton blouse with rolled sleeves, dark-brown trousers, dark-green cloth apron, plastic sandals.
@Thu.voice: woman of 34, strictly standard Hà Nội Northern accent (never Southern accent), soft warm mezzo, gentle but firm, speaking at a brisk, fluent pace, every word spoken once clearly without stutter

@Tung.name: Tùng
@Tung.anchor: Tùng, 37, Thu's husband, newly rich construction company director; tall, slightly heavy, neatly gelled black hair, clean-shaven, heavy-lidded confident eyes; tailored charcoal-grey suit, white shirt open at the collar, gold wristwatch, polished black shoes.
@Tung.voice: man of 37, strictly standard Hà Nội Northern accent (never Southern accent), deep confident baritone, impatient and cold, speaking at a brisk, fast-clipped pace, every word spoken once clearly without stutter

@Vy.name: Vy
@Vy.anchor: Vy, 24, Tùng's glamorous new secretary; slender and striking, long glossy wavy dark-brown hair, sharp feline eyes with winged eyeliner, red lipstick; fitted crimson sleeveless midi dress, thin gold necklace, beige high heels, small white handbag with no logo.
@Vy.voice: young woman of 24, strictly standard Hà Nội Northern accent (never Southern accent), sweet honeyed soprano that turns cold and sharp, speaking at a brisk, fast-clipped pace, every word spoken once clearly without stutter

@BaNhan.name: Bà Nhàn
@BaNhan.anchor: Bà Nhàn, 70, Tùng's mother who lives with Thu; small and thin, white hair in a neat low bun, kind deeply wrinkled face; brown knitted cardigan over a grey blouse, black trousers, cloth slippers, carved bamboo walking stick.
@BaNhan.voice: old woman of 70, strictly standard Hà Nội Northern accent (never Southern accent), frail raspy voice, trembling but firm, speaking at a brisk pace, every word spoken once clearly without stutter

@Na.name: Na
@Na.anchor: Na, 9, Thu and Tùng's daughter; small, round face, bright dark eyes, black hair in two short pigtails with red hair ties; white short-sleeve school shirt, navy pleated skirt, red scarf knotted at the neck, white canvas shoes.
@Na.voice: girl of 9, strictly standard Hà Nội Northern accent (never Southern accent), high clear child's voice, earnest, speaking at a brisk pace, every word spoken once clearly without stutter

@Khai.name: Khải
@Khai.anchor: Khải, 30, Vy's secret lover and partner in her scheme; lean, styled black undercut hair, thin moustache, sly half-smile; black slim-fit shirt with rolled sleeves, beige chinos, white sneakers, silver chain bracelet.
@Khai.voice: man of 30, strictly standard Hà Nội Northern accent (never Southern accent), smooth lazy tenor, sly and mocking, speaking at a brisk, fast-clipped pace, every word spoken once clearly without stutter

scenes.title: Người Đàn Bà Thức Dậy Trước Mặt Trời
scenes.time_label: 04:00 Rạng sáng, phố cổ Hà Nội (00:00–01:00)
scenes.location: Mái ngói phố cổ Hà Nội lúc rạng sáng (clip 1), rồi gian bếp tầng trệt căn nhà ống ba tầng trong một ngõ nhỏ.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt phía bàn ăn nhìn vào bếp: nồi đồ xôi bên trái, cầu thang dốc bên phải, kệ có camera nhỏ trên cao phía sau.
scenes.props: Nồi đồ xôi nhôm lớn, lá chuối, bát xôi, bàn thờ nhỏ với ba nén hương, gậy tre của bà Nhàn, chiếc camera nhỏ màu trắng trên kệ bếp.
scenes.setting: Inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a ground-floor kitchen with a gas stove and a big aluminum sticky-rice steamer, a wooden dining table with low stools, a steep tiled staircase, a small family altar shelf, a small white home camera on a high kitchen shelf.

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Mới bốn giờ sáng, cả phố còn ngủ say, con dâu tôi đã lục đục dưới bếp đồ xôi rồi.
clips.camera: 24mm aerial descending glide from the rooftops down to an upper-floor window
beats: High aerial view over the dark tiled roofs of the old quarter before dawn, thin mist drifting between rooftops and yellow streetlamps glowing in the narrow alleys below.

The camera glides down past tangled overhead wires to a small upper-floor window of a narrow tube house, where @BaNhan swings open the wooden shutters and murmurs to herself, her wrinkled face clear in the lamplight.
@BaNhan closes her mouth and gazes down at the warm light and soft steam spilling from the kitchen window below, one hand pressed to her lower back.
clips.sfx: a distant rooster, a cold breeze, wooden shutters creaking, a soft hiss of steam below
clips.setting: Pre-dawn aerial over the tiled roofs of Hà Nội's old quarter: mist, yellow streetlamps, a few lit kitchen windows.

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Con lạy tổ tiên, mười hai năm làm dâu, con chỉ xin chồng con làm ăn suôn sẻ, cả nhà bình an.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot, slow push-in toward the altar shelf
beats: The dim kitchen before dawn, a big aluminum sticky-rice steamer rattling on the gas stove beside a small family altar shelf glowing with a tiny red lamp.
@Thu steps in front of the altar shelf in her green apron, raises three lit incense sticks to her forehead and whispers a prayer, her lips moving softly in the red glow.
@Thu closes her mouth, plants the incense sticks in the small bowl on the shelf and turns toward the steamer as a thick cloud of steam rolls up.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, the steamer lid rattling, the gas flame purring, a faint crackle of incense

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Hồi anh ấy còn trắng tay, cả nhà sống nhờ mấy gói xôi này, tay có chai đi một chút cũng chẳng sao.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up framing her face and hands over the table, slow tilt
beats: @Thu bends over the wooden table with her face and work-roughened hands both in frame, scooping warm sticky rice onto a square of green banana leaf as she starts to murmur to herself.
@Thu keeps murmuring with a faint wry smile, her lips moving clearly while her fingers fold the banana-leaf corners into a neat parcel.
@Thu closes her mouth and sets the finished parcel beside a growing row of identical green parcels, her calloused fingertips resting on the last one.
clips.sfx: banana leaves rustling, a soft steam hiss, the gas flame purring

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Lưng đau quá không ngủ được, thôi xuống đỡ con Thu một tay, nó gánh cả cái nhà này rồi.
clips.camera: 40mm medium low-angle shot from the foot of the staircase, slow tilt up
beats: The steep tiled staircase in the dim light, a faint glow from the kitchen climbing the steps, the upper floor still dark.
@BaNhan comes slowly down the stairs in her brown cardigan, leaning on her bamboo walking stick, and mutters to herself with her wrinkled face turned toward the light.
@BaNhan closes her mouth and pauses on the lowest step with one hand pressed to her lower back, her eyes fixed on the warm kitchen.
clips.sfx: slow footsteps on tiles, the tap of a bamboo stick, steam hissing below

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Thu ơi, con nghỉ tay ăn miếng xôi đi đã, tối qua thằng Tùng lại về muộn hả con?
clips.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder two-shot across the dining table, slow dolly
beats: The wooden dining table beside the stove, a plate of banana-leaf parcels and two low stools, steam drifting through the warm light.
@BaNhan lowers herself onto a stool by the table as @Thu turns from the stove, and @BaNhan speaks to her softly, her wrinkled face creased with concern.
@BaNhan finishes speaking and keeps her eyes on @Thu, both hands resting on top of her bamboo stick.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, a stool creaking, a rooster outside

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Anh ấy dạo này nhiều việc lắm mẹ ạ, mẹ cứ lên ngủ thêm đi, con lo được hết.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up over the table, slow push-in
beats: @Thu sets a small bowl of warm sticky rice in front of @BaNhan, wiping her hands on her green apron.
@Thu speaks gently with a thin tired smile, her eyes sliding away toward the dark staircase.
@Thu turns back to the stove and lifts the steamer lid again, her shoulders tight under the faded blue blouse.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, chopsticks against a bowl, a distant moped

scenes.title: Đôi Bông Tai Đã Bán
scenes.location: Gánh xôi nhỏ của Thu dưới chiếc ô bạc màu ở một góc vỉa hè phố cổ lúc hửng sáng; clip 3 ở bếp nhà Thu (bà Nhàn nói với camera).
scenes.axis: Máy quay trên vỉa hè nhìn vào gánh xôi: nồi xôi bên trái Thu, lòng đường và xe máy phía sau bên phải.
scenes.props: Thúng tre, nồi xôi bốc khói, lá chuối, ghế nhựa thấp, hộp bông tai nhung đỏ rỗng, điện thoại cũ của Thu, chiếc camera nhỏ màu trắng trên kệ bếp.
scenes.setting: Dawn on a Hà Nội old-quarter pavement corner: a small sticky-rice stall with a bamboo basket, a steaming pot and banana leaves under a big faded umbrella, low plastic stools, mopeds passing, blue-grey dawn light and yellow streetlamps.

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Cô ơi, sương lạnh thế này, cô ngồi làm gói xôi nóng đã, sáng nào cháu cũng phần cô một gói.
clips.camera: 24mm wide establishing shot, slow lateral track along the pavement
beats: A quiet old-quarter street corner at dawn, yellow streetlamps still glowing and mist over the pavement, a small sticky-rice stall steaming under a big faded umbrella.
@Thu lifts the lid of the steaming pot as an elderly woman street sweeper in an orange vest pauses by the stall with her bamboo broom, and @Thu calls to her warmly with a bright smile.
@Thu closes her mouth and holds out a warm banana-leaf parcel across the basket, and the sweeper leans her broom on the umbrella pole and takes it with both hands.
clips.sfx: a moped passing, steam hissing, a bamboo broom sweeping the pavement
clips.extras: an elderly woman street sweeper in an orange vest with a bamboo broom

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Đôi bông tai cưới, của hồi môn duy nhất, mười hai năm trước mình bán đi cho anh ấy làm vốn.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow push-in
beats: Close on the stall's low plastic stool and the bamboo basket of banana leaves, steam drifting across the frame in the grey dawn.
@Thu sits on the low stool, opens a small empty red velvet earring box with her thumb and murmurs to herself, her lips moving softly as she gazes at the bare velvet.
@Thu closes her mouth and rests her thumb on the empty velvet slot, her eyes glistening in the grey dawn light.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, the soft click of a box lid, a moped far away

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Thu ơi, thằng Tùng nó làm giám đốc rồi, con còn ra gánh xôi làm gì cho khổ thân hả con?
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot, slow push-in toward the high kitchen shelf
beats: Early morning light in the narrow kitchen, the small white home camera on the high kitchen shelf blinking its tiny light above the empty dining table and a covered plate of banana-leaf parcels.
@BaNhan shuffles into the kitchen on her bamboo walking stick, looks up at the small white home camera and speaks up to it with a fond crinkled smile.
@BaNhan closes her mouth and gives the camera a small wave, then lowers herself onto a stool beside the covered plate of parcels.
clips.sfx: a bamboo stick tapping on tiles, a stool creaking, a rooster outside
clips.setting: Inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a ground-floor kitchen with a gas stove and a big aluminum sticky-rice steamer, a wooden dining table with low stools, a steep tiled staircase, a small family altar shelf, a small white home camera on a high kitchen shelf.

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Mẹ ơi, anh ấy giàu thì giàu, con vẫn phải giữ cái nghề, lỡ mai kia nhà mình lại trắng tay.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow rack focus
beats: The edge of the stall's low stool with an old cracked smartphone lying face-up beside the basket, its screen glowing blank in the dawn light.
@Thu picks up the old phone, looks at its glowing blank screen with a soft laugh, then holds it close to her mouth and speaks into it warmly.
@Thu closes her mouth with a small relieved smile and slips the phone back into her apron pocket as steam drifts past the umbrella.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, a distant moped, soft dawn birdsong

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Xôi xéo hành phi nóng đây, chị ăn thử đi, em gói thêm cho chị ít ruốc nhé!
clips.camera: 35mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the customer, gentle dolly
beats: The steaming pot under the faded umbrella, banana-leaf parcels lined up in the bamboo basket, a moped parked at the curb.
@Thu stands behind the pot facing a woman customer in a pink raincoat, holds up a warm banana-leaf parcel and speaks to her with a bright smile.
@Thu finishes speaking and tucks an extra spoonful of pork floss into the parcel, then hands it across the basket as the customer nods.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, rustling banana leaves, mopeds passing
clips.extras: a woman customer in a pink raincoat

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Chồng em làm ở tòa nhà kính đằng kia chị ạ, ngày xưa hai vợ chồng chỉ dám đứng dưới đường mà nhìn.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot, slow crane up into a wide view
beats: @Thu wipes her hands on her green apron and nods toward the distant skyline, starting to speak to the customer in the pink raincoat with a shy proud smile.
@Thu keeps speaking with her face turned up toward the far glass towers, a wistful light in her eyes, as the camera begins to rise above the faded umbrella.
The camera keeps rising above the umbrella to reveal glass towers on the distant skyline catching the sunrise, while @Thu stands silent beside the tiny steaming stall below.
clips.sfx: mopeds, morning street noise rising, steam hissing
clips.extras: a woman customer in a pink raincoat

scenes.title: Ông Giám Đốc Mới Phất
scenes.location: Gian bếp kiêm phòng ăn tầng trệt căn nhà ống của Thu, buổi sáng.
scenes.axis: Cửa ra ngõ bên phải màn hình, cầu thang và gương treo bên trái, bàn ăn ở giữa.
scenes.props: Gương treo cạnh cầu thang, chiếc trống con màu đỏ của Na, bát xôi hành phi, cặp tài liệu da và điện thoại của Tùng.
scenes.setting: Inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a ground-floor kitchen with a gas stove and a big aluminum sticky-rice steamer, a wooden dining table with low stools, a steep tiled staircase, a small family altar shelf, a small white home camera on a high kitchen shelf.

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Cậu đánh xe ra đầu ngõ đón tôi, lau cho bóng vào, hôm nay tôi ký hợp đồng lớn đấy.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot, slow push-in toward the mirror
beats: Morning light through the open front door of the narrow house, a small mirror hanging beside the steep tiled staircase, a leather briefcase on a stool.
@Tung steps in front of the mirror in his charcoal-grey suit with a sleek phone pressed to his ear, smoothing his gelled hair as he speaks into it in a clipped bossy tone.
@Tung closes his mouth, lowers the phone and fastens the gold watch on his wrist, studying his reflection with his chin raised.
clips.sfx: a moped outside, the click of a watch clasp, morning birds

clips.speaker: @Na
clips.line: Lần này mình phải rủ được bố đi xem diễn, năm nào cũng chỉ có mẹ với bà đến thôi.
clips.camera: 50mm close-up at child height, slow dolly-in
beats: The foot of the steep staircase seen from child height, a small red toy drum with two wooden sticks resting on the bottom step in the morning light.
@Na comes down the last steps in her school uniform and red scarf, hugs the little red drum to her chest and whispers to herself, her bright eyes turned toward the mirror.
@Na closes her mouth and rises onto her toes at the bottom of the stairs, holding the drum tight, waiting with a hopeful face.
clips.sfx: light footsteps on tiles, a soft drum tap, a moped outside

clips.speaker: @Na
clips.line: Bố ơi, chiều nay bố đến xem con đánh trống nhé, cô giáo bảo ai cũng có bố mẹ đến.
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot, slow dolly
beats: The space beside the mirror and the staircase, a leather briefcase on a stool, warm morning light falling across the tiled floor.
@Na steps up to @Tung holding the little red drum to her chest and speaks up at him, her pigtails bobbing.
@Na finishes and waits with her eyes fixed on @Tung's face, her small fingers tight around the drumsticks.
clips.sfx: a moped outside, morning birds

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Bố bận họp cả ngày, con bảo mẹ đi xem cho, bố còn phải kiếm tiền nuôi cả nhà.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up over the drum, slow push-in
beats: @Tung glances down at @Na and gives the top of her head one quick distracted pat, his other hand already lifting his briefcase.
@Tung speaks to @Na while checking the gold watch on his wrist, his eyes never quite meeting hers.
@Na lowers the little red drum slowly to her side, her lower lip tucked in as @Tung turns away toward the door.
clips.sfx: a briefcase clasp clicking, footsteps on tiles

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Anh ăn bát xôi rồi hẵng đi, em đồ từ sáng sớm, vẫn còn nóng nguyên đây này.
clips.camera: 35mm wide two-shot from the kitchen, slow lateral dolly
beats: The kitchen near the open front door, a bowl of steaming sticky rice with fried shallots resting on the wooden dining table.
@Thu comes from the stove carrying the bowl of steaming sticky rice in both hands and speaks to @Tung as he reaches the doorway.
@Thu holds the bowl out toward @Tung across the gap between them, steam rising between her hands.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, a moped idling outside

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Thôi, xôi với chả xôi, ngày nào cũng xôi, anh ra ngoài ăn cho sạch sẽ.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot, slow push-in on the bowl
beats: @Tung looks at the bowl with a curl of his lip, already half-turned toward the open front door.
@Tung speaks curtly over his shoulder and walks out into the bright alley without looking back, his briefcase swinging.
@Thu stands alone in the doorway holding the steaming bowl in both hands, the steam thinning in the cold morning air.
clips.sfx: footsteps leaving, a car door shutting outside, an engine pulling away

scenes.title: Cô Thư Ký Váy Đỏ
scenes.location: Phòng giám đốc tường kính trên tầng cao một tòa tháp giữa Hà Nội.
scenes.axis: Bàn làm việc trắng ở giữa, cửa kính nhìn ra thành phố phía sau; cửa ra vào bên trái màn hình.
scenes.props: Bàn trắng, khung ảnh gia đình Thu – Tùng – Na, hộp cơm sơn mài đen bóng, mô hình tòa nhà, túi giấy mua mang về.
scenes.setting: A modern glass-walled director's office high in a Hà Nội tower: a large white desk with a family photo frame, a black leather chair, an architectural model of a residential tower, the city skyline beyond the windows.

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Tầng hai mươi, nhìn ra cả thành phố, rồi cả căn phòng này lẫn ông chủ của nó sẽ là của mình.
clips.camera: 24mm wide shot, slow dolly through the glass office
beats: A bright glass-walled office high above the city, the large white desk gleaming in cold morning light with the skyline stretching beyond the windows.
@Vy walks in through the glass door in her crimson dress and beige high heels, mists a little perfume into the air by the desk and murmurs to herself with a slow smile.
@Vy closes her red lips and runs one fingertip along the back of the black leather chair, her winged eyes sweeping across the skyline.
clips.sfx: high heels clicking on a polished floor, a soft perfume spritz, air conditioning hum

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Vy à, em về làm thư ký mới ba tháng mà phòng anh lúc nào cũng thơm mùi nước hoa của em.
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot, slow push-in
beats: The white desk with a glossy black lacquered lunch box resting beside a framed family photo of Thu, Tùng and Na, the city skyline blurred in the windows behind.
@Tung strolls in through the glass door with his briefcase and finds @Vy standing by the desk, and he speaks to her with a slow pleased grin, breathing in the air.
@Tung closes his mouth and sinks into the black leather chair, while @Vy stands beside the desk turning her thin gold necklace between her fingers.
clips.sfx: a glass door sighing shut, footsteps on a polished floor, air conditioning hum

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Anh Tùng ơi, em tự tay nấu cơm trưa cho anh đấy, dạo này anh gầy đi nhiều quá.
clips.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder shot, slow push-in
beats: @Vy slides a glossy black lacquered lunch box across the white desk toward @Tung and begins to speak in a sweet soft voice.
@Vy keeps speaking as she leans one hand on the edge of the desk, tilting her head with a honeyed smile while @Tung looks up at her.
@Vy closes her mouth and waits with her head tilted, her red nails resting beside the lunch box, as @Tung reaches for the lid.
clips.sfx: a lunch box sliding on the desk, air conditioning hum

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Lâu lắm rồi mới có người lo cho anh một bữa trưa tử tế thế này đấy em ạ.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow rack focus between them
beats: @Tung lifts the lid of a glossy black lacquered lunch box and looks at the neat rows of food inside.
@Tung speaks to @Vy with a slow pleased grin, leaning back in the black leather chair.
@Vy lowers her eyes with a modest closed-mouth smile, her fingers trailing along the edge of the white desk.
clips.sfx: a lid lifting, chair leather creaking, faint traffic below

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Cơm nhà hàng dưới phố đấy, đàn ông chỉ cần nghe hai chữ tự tay là mềm lòng ngay.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot, slow lateral dolly
beats: A slim waste bin beside the glass wall of the office, cold city light falling across the polished floor.
@Vy walks to the glass wall, drops a crumpled plain paper takeaway bag into the waste bin and murmurs under her breath with a mocking little smile, glancing back over her shoulder.
@Vy closes her red lips, brushes her palms together and smooths the front of her crimson dress, her eyes cold.
clips.sfx: paper crumpling, high heels on the floor, air conditioning hum

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Nhà ba người đẹp quá nhỉ, tiếc là tấm ảnh này sắp phải thay người đứng cạnh anh rồi.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on the desk corner, slow push-in
beats: @Vy strolls back to the corner of the white desk, tilts her head toward a framed family photo of Thu, Tùng and Na and speaks to it in a sugary whisper.
@Vy keeps whispering with a sweet smile as she reaches out one manicured finger and slowly lays the frame face down on the desk.
@Vy closes her mouth, her red fingernails resting on the back of the face-down frame, her smile reflected cold in the glossy white surface.
clips.sfx: a soft tap of a frame on the desk, air conditioning hum

scenes.title: Người Tình Bí Mật
scenes.time_label: 12:00 Trưa, quán cà phê kín đáo (04:00–05:00)
scenes.location: Một quán cà phê sang trọng, kín đáo, cách tòa nhà văn phòng ba con phố.
scenes.axis: Bàn trong góc khuất bên phải màn hình sau chậu cau cảnh, cửa sổ cao nhìn ra phố cây xanh bên trái.
scenes.props: Ghế bành nhung, đèn đồng, bàn đá cẩm thạch, hai tách cà phê, kính râm và điện thoại của Vy, điện thoại và vòng tay bạc của Khải.
scenes.setting: An upscale café at noon: velvet armchairs, brass lamps, marble tables, tall windows facing a leafy street.

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Anh yêu ơi, em ra rồi đây, em bảo lão là đi gặp khách hàng, anh ngồi chỗ nào đấy?
clips.camera: 24mm wide establishing shot, slow pan across the room
beats: A hushed upscale café at noon, sunlight filtering through tall windows onto velvet armchairs and marble tables under warm brass lamps.
@Vy slips in through the café door in her crimson dress and dark sunglasses, a phone pressed to her ear, and speaks into it in a low honeyed voice while glancing around.
@Vy closes her mouth and keeps the phone to her ear, listening, her eyes searching toward a secluded corner half-hidden behind a tall potted palm.
clips.sfx: soft clinking of cups, a café door chime, muted street sounds

clips.speaker: @Khai
clips.line: Góc trong cùng, sau chậu cau ấy, em cứ đi thẳng vào, chỗ này kín đáo, chẳng ai nhìn thấy đâu.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot, slow push-in
beats: The secluded corner table behind the potted palm, two coffee cups on the marble and a velvet armchair angled toward the window.
@Khai leans back in the velvet armchair in his black slim-fit shirt with a phone at his ear, and speaks into it in a lazy low voice with a sly half-smile.
@Khai closes his mouth, sets the phone face down on the marble and lifts his coffee cup slightly toward the café entrance, his silver chain bracelet catching the lamplight.
clips.sfx: cups clinking, a low murmur, a café door chime

clips.speaker: @Khai
clips.line: Thế nào em, lão giám đốc cắn câu chưa? Hợp đồng lớn sắp ký rồi đấy.
clips.camera: 35mm over-the-shoulder two-shot, gentle dolly
beats: The corner table in warm lamplight, an empty velvet armchair facing the one by the window, a steaming cup set before it.
@Vy sinks into the empty armchair and slips off her sunglasses as @Khai leans toward her across the marble table and speaks in a low lazy voice.
@Khai taps one finger on the table with a sly grin, waiting, while @Vy folds her hands on her white handbag and studies him.
clips.sfx: cups clinking, a low café murmur

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Nửa năm thôi anh, em sẽ khiến lão bỏ vợ, sang tên hết nhà cửa cho em.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow push-in
beats: @Vy stirs her coffee slowly, the spoon circling, her winged eyes lifting to meet @Khai's.
@Vy speaks to @Khai in a cool clipped voice, the sweetness gone from her face.
@Vy sets the spoon down on the saucer with a precise click and leans back, her red lips pressed into a thin line.
clips.sfx: a spoon clinking on porcelain, a low café murmur

clips.speaker: @Khai
clips.line: Đừng để lão biết có anh, đàn ông ngu đến mấy cũng có lúc tỉnh ra đấy em.
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot, slow lateral dolly
beats: @Khai rests his elbows on the marble table and lowers his head toward @Vy, his half-smile fading.
@Khai speaks quietly to @Vy, glancing once toward the café windows and the leafy street outside.
@Khai sits back and lifts his coffee cup in a small toast toward @Vy, his eyes sharp above the rim.
clips.sfx: a low café murmur, a car passing outside

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Anh yên tâm, lão mê em như điếu đổ, đến lúc lão tỉnh ra thì lão đã trắng tay rồi.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on her face over the coffee cup, slow push-in
beats: @Vy stirs her coffee in slow circles with a silver spoon and answers @Khai with a sweet smile, her red lips moving softly.
@Vy keeps speaking as the sweetness drains from her face, her winged eyes lifting cold and still above the cup.
@Vy closes her mouth and sets the spoon on the saucer with a precise click, while @Khai raises his cup to her at the soft edge of the frame.
clips.sfx: a spoon circling porcelain, a soft café murmur

scenes.title: Sợi Tóc Trên Áo Chồng
scenes.location: Gian bếp tầng trệt căn nhà ống lúc gần nửa đêm, chỉ một bóng đèn vàng và bếp than.
scenes.axis: Bàn ăn và ghế ở giữa, cầu thang dốc bên phải màn hình, bếp than bên trái.
scenes.props: Áo sơ mi trắng của Tùng có vệt son đỏ và sợi tóc nâu xoăn, cà vạt lụa, đôi giày đen, bếp than.
scenes.setting: Night inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a dim ground-floor kitchen lit by one warm bulb and a charcoal stove, a wooden dining table, a steep tiled staircase, a small white home camera with a tiny green light on a high kitchen shelf.

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Thằng Tùng lại gần nửa đêm mới về, mùi rượu lẫn mùi nước hoa lạ nồng nặc cả nhà.
clips.camera: 35mm wide shot, slow dolly-in across the kitchen
beats: The dim kitchen at night lit by one warm bulb, the charcoal stove glowing low, a white dress shirt and a loosened silk tie draped carelessly over a dining chair.
@BaNhan comes slowly down the steep staircase leaning on her bamboo walking stick, stops beside the chair, sniffs the air and mutters to herself with her wrinkled face tight.
@BaNhan closes her mouth and stares at the rumpled white shirt hanging from the chair, a pair of polished black shoes left askew beneath it.
clips.sfx: the charcoal stove crackling softly, a dog barking far away, a door closing upstairs

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Khuya rồi con còn xuống làm gì, áo của nó cứ để đấy, đêm nào con cũng phải giặt cho nó à?
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot, slow push-in
beats: The wooden dining chair under the warm bulb, the white shirt and loose tie draped over its back, the charcoal stove glowing beside it.
@Thu comes down the last stairs in her faded blouse and picks up the white shirt from the chair, as @BaNhan, leaning on her stick by the table, speaks to her in a low tired voice.
@BaNhan closes her mouth and shakes her head slowly, while @Thu folds the shirt over her arm and lifts the collar toward the light, her brows drawing together.
clips.sfx: soft footsteps, fabric rustling, the stove crackling

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Mẹ ơi, son đỏ trên cổ áo, còn sợi tóc xoăn màu nâu này, đâu phải tóc của con.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on her face above the collar, slow rack focus
beats: @Thu turns the white collar toward the bulb beside her face, revealing a smudge of bright red lipstick on the fabric, and starts to speak to @BaNhan in a trembling whisper.
@Thu keeps speaking as she lifts a single long wavy brown hair from the shoulder of the shirt and holds it up in the warm light beside her face.
@Thu closes her mouth, her eyes wide and wet above the shirt, while @BaNhan's wrinkled hand tightens on her bamboo stick at the edge of the frame.
clips.sfx: a sharp intake of breath, the stove crackling, silence

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Anh Tùng, vệt son trên áo anh là của ai? Anh nói thật với em đi.
clips.camera: 35mm wide two-shot from the kitchen doorway, slow dolly
beats: The foot of the steep staircase in the dim warm light, the dining table between the stairs and the glowing stove.
@Tung appears on the lower stairs loosening his collar, and @Thu holds up the white shirt toward him from across the table and speaks in a trembling but steady voice.
@Thu keeps the shirt raised between them, her knuckles pale, while @Tung stops two steps above the floor.
clips.sfx: the stove crackling, a creaking stair

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Tiếp khách thì dính son là chuyện thường, cô đừng nghĩ linh tinh rồi làm ầm lên.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow push-in
beats: @Tung rolls his eyes and waves one hand dismissively, stepping down onto the tiled floor.
@Tung speaks flatly to @Thu without looking at the shirt, his jaw set and his eyelids heavy with drink.
@Tung turns his back on @Thu and climbs the stairs again, one hand on the rail, leaving her below.
clips.sfx: heavy footsteps on the stairs, the stove crackling

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Bao nhiêu năm vợ chồng, đến một câu nói thật anh ấy cũng chẳng cho mình nữa rồi.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot from the kitchen, slow push-in
beats: The bottom of the steep tiled staircase in the dim kitchen, the bulb's warm light fading and the charcoal stove reduced to faint embers.
@Thu sits down on the lowest stair with the white shirt clutched in both hands in her lap and whispers to herself, her lips trembling, her back against the wall.
@Thu closes her mouth and sits motionless on the step as pale blue dawn light slowly creeps under the front door, the shirt still crushed in her hands.
clips.sfx: embers ticking, a distant rooster at dawn, silence

scenes.title: Chuyến Công Tác Đà Nẵng
scenes.time_label: Chiều tà, khu nghỉ dưỡng biển (06:00–07:00)
scenes.location: Hồ bơi vô cực của một khu nghỉ dưỡng sang trọng ven biển lúc hoàng hôn; clip 5–6 ở bếp nhà Thu ban đêm.
scenes.axis: Hai ghế dài trắng bên mép hồ bơi, biển phía sau bên trái màn hình; ở nhà Thu, bàn ăn ở giữa, ghế trống của Tùng bên phải.
scenes.props: Ghế dài trắng, hai ly nước cam, điện thoại của Tùng, chiếc bánh sinh nhật nhỏ có một ngọn nến, ghế trống của Tùng.
scenes.setting: Sunset at a luxury seaside resort: an infinity pool terrace with white loungers, palm trees, the sea glowing orange.

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Anh còn kẹt công tác ở Đà Nẵng, sinh nhật em anh không về kịp, em với con cứ ăn trước đi.
clips.camera: 24mm aerial slow descending orbit down to the pool terrace
beats: High aerial view of a luxury seaside resort at sunset, palm trees swaying above a long curve of golden beach and a calm orange sea.
The camera sweeps down to the infinity pool terrace, where @Tung, his suit jacket off, stands by a white lounger with a phone at his ear and speaks into it in a flat dutiful voice.
@Tung closes his mouth, lowers the phone and tosses it onto the lounger with a smirk, the pool's edge blending into the shining sea behind him.
clips.sfx: gentle waves, palm fronds rustling, distant seabirds

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Công tác gì mà chỉ có hai đứa mình, bên bể bơi nhìn ra biển thế này hả anh?
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot, slow lateral dolly along the pool
beats: Two white loungers at the edge of the infinity pool, a small table between them holding two glasses of orange juice, the sea glowing beyond.
@Vy in her crimson dress sits on one lounger and hands @Tung a glass of orange juice as he settles beside her, and she teases him in a sweet mocking voice.
@Vy closes her mouth and clinks her glass against @Tung's, the two of them sitting close and gazing out at the orange sea.
clips.sfx: gentle waves, glasses clinking, a soft breeze

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Ở bên anh em mới biết thế nào là được yêu, vợ anh có biết chiều anh thế này không?
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow push-in
beats: @Vy turns toward @Tung on the lounger, resting her chin on her hand, the sunset gilding her wavy hair.
@Vy speaks to @Tung in a sweet coaxing voice, her winged eyes half-lowered.
@Vy tilts her head and waits with a soft closed-mouth smile, turning the glass slowly between her fingers.
clips.sfx: waves lapping, a soft breeze

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Cô ấy chỉ biết xôi với chợ thôi em ạ, sống với cô ấy anh thấy mình già đi mười tuổi.
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot, slow pull-back
beats: @Tung sets his glass down on the small table and leans back on the lounger with a long sigh.
@Tung speaks to @Vy with a dismissive shrug, his eyes on the darkening sea.
@Vy lays her hand lightly over @Tung's on the armrest as the last sunlight fades behind them.
clips.sfx: waves, a breeze through the palms

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Bố bận công tác rồi, sinh nhật mẹ con ước giúp mẹ một điều đi, rồi mình thổi nến.
clips.camera: 40mm over-the-shoulder shot across the birthday cake, slow push-in
beats: The wooden dining table in the dim kitchen at night, a small round birthday cake with a single unlit candle, three bowls and one empty chair.
@Na carefully lights the single candle with a match while @Thu, facing the camera across the cake, speaks to her softly with a thin brave smile, both faces lit by the tiny flame.
@Thu closes her mouth and rests her hand on @Na's shoulder as both glance at the empty chair across the table, the candle flickering between them.
clips.sfx: a match striking, a faint candle hiss, rain beginning outside
clips.setting: Night inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a dim ground-floor kitchen lit by one warm bulb and a charcoal stove, a wooden dining table, a steep tiled staircase, a small white home camera with a tiny green light on a high kitchen shelf.

clips.speaker: @Na
clips.line: Mẹ ơi, con ước bố về ăn cơm với mẹ con mình, như hồi nhà mình còn nghèo ấy.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow push-in
beats: @Na clasps her small hands together in front of the candle and closes her eyes for a moment.
@Na opens her eyes and speaks softly to @Thu, her face glowing in the candlelight.
@Thu presses her lips together and strokes @Na's hair, her eyes glistening as the candle flame trembles.
clips.sfx: a candle flickering, soft rain on the roof
clips.setting: Night inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a dim ground-floor kitchen lit by one warm bulb and a charcoal stove, a wooden dining table, a steep tiled staircase, a small white home camera with a tiny green light on a high kitchen shelf.

scenes.title: Bức Ảnh Lúc Nửa Đêm
scenes.location: Gian bếp tầng trệt căn nhà ống lúc nửa đêm; clip cuối ở chiếu nghỉ cầu thang.
scenes.axis: Bàn ăn ở giữa, bếp bên trái, cầu thang bên phải màn hình dẫn lên chiếu nghỉ.
scenes.props: Điện thoại của Tùng (màn hình chỉ phát sáng, không chữ), chìa khóa xe, bàn ăn gỗ, gậy tre của bà Nhàn.
scenes.setting: Night inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a dim ground-floor kitchen lit by one warm bulb and a charcoal stove, a wooden dining table, a steep tiled staircase, a small white home camera with a tiny green light on a high kitchen shelf.

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Anh Tuấn kế toán à? Nửa đêm rồi, kế toán gì mà gọi cho anh ấy vào giờ này?
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot, slow push-in on the table
beats: The dining table in the dim kitchen, a sleek black smartphone lying face-up beside a car key, the bulb casting a warm circle of light.
The phone buzzes with a blank white glow as @Thu steps over from the stove, looks down at it and murmurs to herself, her brows knitting, her face lit from below.
@Thu closes her mouth and hesitates with her damp hand hovering above the glowing phone, glancing once toward the dark staircase.
clips.sfx: a phone buzzing on wood, a dripping tap

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Trời ơi, cô gái váy đỏ này đang tựa vào vai chồng mình, anh Tuấn kế toán là thế này đây à?
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow push-in on her face
beats: @Thu picks up the phone and its screen casts a cold white glow up across her face, her eyes fixing on it as her lips start to move in a broken whisper.
@Thu keeps whispering with her pupils trembling and her voice catching, the phone shaking slightly in her hand.
@Thu closes her mouth and slowly presses her free hand over it, a single tear sliding down her cheek in the cold light.
clips.sfx: the tap dripping, a heavy silence

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Cô lục điện thoại của tôi à? Cô còn biết tôn trọng chồng mình không hả?
clips.camera: 35mm wide two-shot from the stove, slow dolly
beats: The steep staircase and the dining table in the dim kitchen, the phone's cold glow the brightest light in the room.
@Tung strides down the last stairs and stops on the far side of the table from @Thu, pointing at the phone in her hand as he speaks sharply.
@Tung holds out his open palm across the table, waiting, while @Thu stays where she is with the phone held against her chest.
clips.sfx: heavy footsteps on tiles, the tap dripping

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Mười hai năm em bán cả bông tai cưới cho anh làm ăn, anh trả em thế này sao?
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow push-in
beats: @Thu sets the glowing phone face-down on the table between them, her hand trembling as she lets go.
@Thu speaks to @Tung with her chin lifted and her voice cracking, tears standing in her eyes.
@Thu keeps her gaze locked on @Tung, breathing hard, her fingers gripping the edge of the table.
clips.sfx: a phone set down on wood, the tap dripping

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Chuyện cũ rồi, đừng lôi ra kể công mãi, tôi chán cái nhà này lắm rồi.
clips.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder shot, slow dolly
beats: @Tung picks his phone up off the table and slips it into his trouser pocket without looking at @Thu.
@Tung speaks coldly to @Thu with a flick of his hand toward the room around them, his mouth twisted.
@Tung turns away and climbs the stairs two at a time, leaving @Thu alone at the table under the swaying bulb.
clips.sfx: footsteps on the stairs, a door shutting hard upstairs

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Tôi nghe hết rồi, thằng con tôi dứt ruột đẻ ra mà nỡ nói với vợ nó những lời như thế.
clips.camera: 50mm medium low-angle shot up the stairwell, slow push-in
beats: A dim tiled stair landing in darkness, a faint warm glow rising from the kitchen below and a closed door above.
@BaNhan stands pressed against the wall of the landing in her brown cardigan, both hands clenched on her bamboo walking stick, and whispers to herself with trembling lips.
@BaNhan closes her mouth, lowers her head and shuts her eyes, her thin shoulders shaking as the light from below flickers across her wrinkled face.
clips.sfx: a door closing upstairs, the faint drip of a tap below, silence
clips.setting: Night on the dim tiled stair landing of the tube house, a faint light from the kitchen below.

scenes.title: Bé Ba Ghé Gánh Xôi
scenes.location: Gánh xôi của Thu ở góc vỉa hè phố cổ Hà Nội lúc rạng sáng.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt phía ngoài phố nhìn vào gánh xôi; Thu đứng sau nồi xôi bên phải, Vy đứng phía vỉa hè bên trái, xe sang đỗ sát lề phía sau Vy.
scenes.props: Nồi xôi bốc khói, mẹt tre, lá chuối, xe sang đen không logo, tờ tiền gấp, kính râm và túi xách trắng của Vy.
scenes.setting: Dawn on a Hà Nội old-quarter pavement corner: a small sticky-rice stall with a bamboo basket, a steaming pot and banana leaves under a big faded umbrella, low plastic stools, mopeds passing, blue-grey dawn light and yellow streetlamps.

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Thì ra bà vợ bán xôi của anh Tùng ngồi ở đây, để xem chị ta mặt mũi thế nào.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot from across the curb, slow pan following her
beats: A black luxury sedan with no badge glides to a stop at the curb beside the small sticky-rice stall, dawn mist curling around its glossy doors.
@Vy steps out of the car in her crimson dress, slipping on dark sunglasses and murmuring to herself with a thin smile, her face and red lips clearly visible as she speaks.
@Vy finishes speaking and closes her lips, then walks slowly toward the steaming stall, her heels clicking on the wet pavement, the car door left open behind her.
clips.sfx: a car engine idling, high heels clicking on wet pavement, mopeds passing

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Chiếc váy đỏ này, đúng là cô gái trong tấm ảnh đêm qua rồi, cô ta đến đây làm gì?
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on her face and hands, slow push-in
beats: Banana leaves and a bamboo basket of steaming sticky rice on the stall table, wisps of steam drifting through the blue dawn light.
@Thu glances up from wrapping a parcel of sticky rice, her hands stopping in mid-fold, and whispers to herself under her breath, her face and lips clearly visible in the dawn light.
@Thu finishes whispering and closes her mouth, standing perfectly still with her eyes fixed on something beyond the stall as the steam drifts across her face.
clips.sfx: steam hissing from the pot, distant mopeds, a dog barking far away

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Chị cho em một gói xôi xéo, nghe nói ngày xưa anh Tùng mê xôi của chị lắm.
clips.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the stall toward the street, locked-off
beats: The front of the stall seen across the steaming pot, a stack of folded banana leaves and an empty low plastic stool on the pavement.
@Vy stops in front of the stall and lowers her sunglasses slightly, smiling sweetly at @Thu, who stands behind the pot holding a banana leaf.
@Vy finishes speaking with her head tilted, one hand resting on her white handbag, while @Thu keeps her eyes steady on her.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, a moped passing, the soft rustle of banana leaves

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Ngày xưa hay bây giờ, anh ấy vẫn là chồng tôi, cô muốn ăn xôi thì cứ ngồi xuống.
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot across the stall, gentle handheld
beats: @Thu sets down the banana leaf and straightens her back, facing @Vy across the steaming pot.
@Thu speaks calmly to @Vy, her jaw firm and her rough hands resting flat on the edge of the stall table.
@Thu gestures once toward the empty plastic stool, her gaze level, while @Vy's smile tightens at the corners.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, a ladle tapping the pot rim, distant traffic

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Chị giữ được bếp, nhưng giữ không nổi chồng đâu chị ạ, nhìn đôi tay chị kìa.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on the woman in red, slow push-in
beats: @Vy takes off her sunglasses and lets her eyes drift slowly down to @Thu's hands on the stall table.
@Vy speaks to @Thu in a soft sweet voice, a thin smile on her red lips, one eyebrow lifting.
@Vy holds her gaze on @Thu's work-roughened hands with her chin lifted, as @Thu's fingers slowly curl inward.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, a moped horn far away

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Đôi bàn tay này nuôi anh ấy mười hai năm, giờ lại bị người ta đem ra chê cười.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot of the lonely stall, slow dolly back
beats: A folded banknote lies on the round bamboo tray of sticky rice, the black luxury sedan with no badge pulling away from the curb in the background.
@Thu stands alone behind the stall, slowly lifts both hands palm up to look at the calluses and cracked skin, and murmurs to herself, her face and lips clearly visible.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, still looking down at her open hands in the blue dawn light as the steam rises around her.
clips.sfx: a car driving away, steam hissing, the first birds of the morning

scenes.title: Mâm Cơm Đòi Ly Hôn
scenes.location: Bếp và bàn ăn tầng trệt nhà ống của Thu trong ngõ phố cổ, buổi tối.
scenes.axis: Máy quay ở phía bếp than nhìn dọc bàn ăn; Tùng ngồi đầu bàn bên trái, Thu ngồi bên phải, bà Nhàn ở góc bàn gần chân cầu thang.
scenes.props: Mâm cơm đủ món (cá kho, rau muống xào, canh cua, nồi cơm), bát đũa, muôi canh, gậy tre của bà Nhàn.
scenes.setting: Night inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a dim ground-floor kitchen lit by one warm bulb and a charcoal stove, a wooden dining table, a steep tiled staircase, a small white home camera with a tiny green light on a high kitchen shelf.

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Anh Tùng ơi, xuống ăn cơm đi anh, hôm nay em nấu cá kho với canh cua anh thích đấy.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot, slow glide along the dinner table
beats: A wooden dining table under one warm bulb, set with a full family dinner of braised fish, stir-fried morning glory, crab soup and a pot of rice, steam curling up from the dishes.
@Thu sets a steaming bowl of crab soup at the head of the table, then turns toward the steep staircase and calls up with a small smile, her face and lips clearly visible.
@Thu finishes calling and closes her mouth, smoothing her apron and waiting beside the table with her eyes on the stairs, four bowls and four pairs of chopsticks laid neatly in place.
clips.sfx: a charcoal stove crackling, a pot lid rattling softly, slow footsteps creaking on the stairs above

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Mình ly hôn đi, tôi không chịu nổi cái mùi bếp núc với gánh xôi của cô nữa.
clips.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind her toward him, locked-off
beats: The dinner table in the warm kitchen light, a pair of chopsticks laid across an untouched bowl of rice.
@Tung sits at the head of the table in his charcoal suit and puts his chopsticks down, speaking flatly to @Thu across the dishes.
@Tung leans back with his arms folded, while @Thu sits motionless in the foreground across from him, a soup ladle still in her hand.
clips.sfx: chopsticks clicking on porcelain, the charcoal stove crackling

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Anh nói lại xem, anh định bỏ mẹ con em vì một đứa con gái kém anh mười mấy tuổi à?
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on her face past his shoulder, slow push-in
beats: @Thu slowly lowers the ladle into the soup bowl, her eyes locked on @Tung.
@Thu speaks to @Tung in a low trembling voice, her chin lifting and her knuckles whitening on the table edge.
@Thu holds his gaze without blinking, a tear sliding down one cheek as her lips press together.
clips.sfx: the soup bowl clinking, rain beginning outside

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Mày vừa nói cái gì hả Tùng? Mẹ còn sống sờ sờ ra đây mà mày dám đòi bỏ vợ à?
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot from the end of the table, slow tilt up
beats: A bamboo walking stick leaning against a low stool at the corner of the dinner table, a small rice bowl in front of it.
@BaNhan rises abruptly from her stool on her bamboo walking stick, her thin hands trembling, and speaks sharply across the table, her wrinkled face and lips clearly visible.
@BaNhan finishes speaking and closes her mouth as the chopsticks slip from her fingers and clatter onto the dinner tray, her eyes fixed hard across the table.
clips.sfx: a stool scraping on tiles, chopsticks clattering onto a tray

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Mày quên ai bán bông tai cưới cho mày làm ăn rồi à? Mày còn là con người không?
clips.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the son toward the mother, locked-off
beats: The dinner tray with scattered chopsticks and cooling dishes, the steep tiled staircase in the dim background.
@BaNhan stands leaning on her bamboo walking stick and speaks sharply across the table to @Tung, her wrinkled face trembling.
@BaNhan points a shaking finger at @Tung from across the table, while @Tung looks away and clenches his jaw.
clips.sfx: rain on the roof, a walking stick tapping the tiled floor

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Mẹ đừng bênh cô ấy nữa, con có quyền được sống cho mình, con quyết rồi mẹ ạ.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on his face, slow push-in
beats: @Tung stands up from the table and buttons his suit jacket, avoiding his mother's eyes.
@Tung speaks coldly to @BaNhan, his jaw tight and his gaze fixed on the front door.
@Tung turns his shoulder away from the table and stands still, breathing hard through his nose.
clips.sfx: rain on the roof, a chair scraping back

scenes.title: Nước Mắt Bên Bếp Than
scenes.location: Bếp than tầng trệt nhà Thu lúc nửa đêm.
scenes.axis: Máy quay từ phía chân cầu thang nhìn vào bếp than; Thu ngồi ghế thấp bên trái bếp, Na đi xuống từ cầu thang bên phải.
scenes.props: Bếp than đất nung, quạt nan, chậu nhôm ngâm gạo nếp, ghế nhựa thấp, bóng đèn vàng, tạp dề xanh của Thu.
scenes.setting: Night inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a dim ground-floor kitchen lit by one warm bulb and a charcoal stove, a wooden dining table, a steep tiled staircase, a small white home camera with a tiny green light on a high kitchen shelf.

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Mười hai năm đồ xôi nuôi anh ấy, giờ anh ấy lại chê nhà mình hôi mùi bếp.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot from the staircase, slow push-in
beats: A glowing charcoal stove in the dark kitchen beside an aluminum basin of soaking sticky rice, a single warm bulb swaying slightly overhead.

@Thu sits alone on a low stool beside the stove, rinsing the soaked rice with both hands and whispering to herself in a thin voice, tears dripping into the basin, her face and lips visible in the orange glow.
@Thu finishes whispering and closes her mouth, her wet hands resting still in the rice and her shoulders shaking silently.
clips.sfx: charcoal crackling, water swishing in a basin, crickets outside

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Không được khóc to, mẹ mà thức dậy thì lại lo, con bé mà nhìn thấy thì nó sợ lắm.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on her face, locked-off
beats: @Thu glances up toward the dark staircase and whispers to herself, her lips moving softly in the stove's orange glow, a tear running down to her chin.
@Thu finishes whispering, closes her mouth and presses the back of her wrist against her lips, holding her breath and listening.
@Thu lowers her wrist and wipes her cheeks with her apron, breathing slowly to steady herself, her lips closed.
clips.sfx: charcoal ticking, a faint snore from upstairs, crickets

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Na à, sao con lại xuống đây? Muộn rồi, con lên ngủ đi, mẹ chỉ ngâm gạo thôi mà.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot from the side of the stove, slow dolly-in
beats: The bottom of the steep tiled staircase in the dim kitchen, the clay stove glowing orange beside the basin of soaking rice.
@Na tiptoes down into the kitchen and wraps her small arms around @Thu's back, and @Thu turns her wet face toward her daughter and speaks softly, her lips clearly visible.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, covering @Na's small hands with her own, while @Na keeps her cheek pressed against her mother's shoulder.
clips.sfx: small footsteps on tiles, charcoal crackling

clips.speaker: @Na
clips.line: Mẹ đừng khóc nữa, bố không cần mẹ thì con với bà cần mẹ, mẹ nhé.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on the girl's face beside her mother's shoulder, locked-off
beats: @Na rests her chin on @Thu's shoulder, her bright eyes wet and wide in the orange stove light.
@Na speaks softly into @Thu's ear, her small hands holding tight around her mother's waist.
@Na leans her forehead against @Thu's cheek and closes her eyes, holding very still.
clips.sfx: charcoal crackling, a soft sniffle

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Ừ, mẹ không khóc nữa, mẹ còn có con, có bà, mẹ phải sống cho đàng hoàng.
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot, slow arc around the stove
beats: @Thu turns on the stool and cups @Na's face in both hands, wiping her daughter's tears with her thumbs.
@Thu speaks to @Na with a small trembling smile, nodding firmly as her own eyes glisten.
@Thu draws @Na into a tight hug, resting her chin on the girl's head, her eyes open and steady on the stove.
clips.sfx: charcoal crackling, rain easing outside

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Cháy lên nào, sáng mai còn cả nồi xôi phải đồ, từ nay không ai bắt mình gục ngã được nữa.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on the clay stove, slow tilt up to her face
beats: Grey charcoal embers inside a clay stove in the dark kitchen, a faint orange glow pulsing between them.
@Thu kneels beside the stove and fans the coals with a woven bamboo hand fan, speaking firmly to herself as the embers flare bright orange, her face and lips lit by the glow.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, fanning steadily with her jaw set, the fierce orange flames filling the bottom of the frame and lighting her dry eyes.
clips.sfx: charcoal crackling and flaring, a bamboo fan swishing, a soft whoosh of air

scenes.title: Hai Vạch Hồng
scenes.location: Căn hộ cao cấp trên cao Tùng thuê cho Vy, buổi sáng.
scenes.axis: Máy quay từ phía sofa nhìn về đảo bếp đá cẩm thạch; cửa kính toàn cảnh phía sau bên phải; Vy đứng bên phải đảo bếp, Tùng bên trái.
scenes.props: Que thử thai hai vạch hồng, điện thoại của Vy (màn hình chỉ phát sáng), đảo bếp đá cẩm thạch trắng, cốc cà phê, chìa khóa xe và ví da của Tùng, bình lan trắng, túi xách trắng của Vy.
scenes.setting: A luxury high-rise apartment in the morning: a white marble kitchen island, a pale sofa, floor-to-ceiling windows over the city, glossy cold light.

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Anh ạ, căn hộ lão Tùng thuê cho em, một tháng tiền nhà bằng cả năm vợ lão bán xôi.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot gliding beside her toward the windows
beats: Morning light pours through floor-to-ceiling windows onto a white marble kitchen island, a pale sofa and a vase of white orchids in an empty luxury apartment.
@Vy strolls across the apartment in her crimson dress with a glowing phone pressed to her ear, speaking into it with a lazy smile, her face and red lips clearly visible.
@Vy finishes speaking and closes her lips, stopping at the glass wall with the phone still at her ear, the city skyline spread out below in glossy cold light.
clips.sfx: a faint city hum far below, an air conditioner whispering, heels on a polished floor

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Que này mua lại của con bạn đang bầu, hai vạch rõ thế này, đàn ông nào chả tin.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow rack focus from the stick to her face
beats: A plastic pregnancy test stick showing two faint pink lines lies on the white marble kitchen island beside a cup of coffee.
@Vy picks up the plastic pregnancy test stick showing two faint pink lines, turns it in her manicured fingers and murmurs to herself with a sly smile, her red lips clearly visible.
@Vy finishes speaking and closes her lips, slipping the test stick into her small white handbag and checking her reflection in the window with a small closed smile.
clips.sfx: a coffee cup set down on marble, distant traffic

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Anh ơi, mình có con rồi, bác sĩ bảo nhiều khả năng là con trai đấy anh.
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot by the kitchen island, locked-off
beats: The marble kitchen island in cold morning light, a set of car keys and a leather wallet lying beside a coffee cup.
@Vy holds out the plastic pregnancy test stick showing two faint pink lines to @Tung, her eyes shining and one hand resting on her flat stomach.
@Tung stares at the test stick in her hand with his eyebrows rising, one hand going to his forehead, while @Vy watches his face with a sweet smile.
clips.sfx: the refrigerator humming, a soft gasp

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Con trai thật à em? Anh sẽ lo cho mẹ con em đầy đủ, anh hứa với em.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on his face, slow push-in
beats: @Tung takes the test stick from @Vy's hand and looks at it, a wide grin spreading across his face.
@Tung speaks eagerly to @Vy, nodding again and again, his eyes bright.
@Tung holds @Vy's hand in both of his and beams at her, while she lowers her eyes with a soft closed smile.
clips.sfx: the city hum, a short delighted laugh

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Nhưng con em không thể là con ngoài giá thú, anh phải ly hôn ngay, sang tên căn nhà cho con.
clips.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind him toward her, locked-off
beats: @Vy slides her hand out of @Tung's hands and lets her smile fade, her eyes turning serious.
@Vy speaks firmly to @Tung, her voice soft but her gaze hard, one fingertip tapping the marble island.
@Vy lifts her chin and waits with her arms folded, as @Tung slowly nods.
clips.sfx: a fingernail tapping marble, the air conditioner humming

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Được, tuần này anh ly hôn, căn nhà ở phố cổ anh sang tên cho con mình luôn.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up two-shot, slow push-in onto her face
beats: @Tung nods at once without hesitation and speaks eagerly to @Vy across the marble island, his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung finishes speaking and closes his mouth, and @Vy steps around the island and leans her head on his shoulder, her face turned toward the camera.
Resting on his shoulder where he cannot see her face, @Vy lets her sweet look drop and her red lips curl slowly into a cold closed smile, her winged eyes narrowing.
clips.sfx: a faint city hum, a slow exhale

scenes.title: Cú Ngã Trên Cầu Thang
scenes.location: Bếp tầng trệt nhà ống của Thu, buổi chiều.
scenes.axis: Máy quay ở góc bếp nhìn về cửa trước; cầu thang dốc bên phải, bếp ga và nồi đồ xôi bên trái; Thu đứng cạnh bếp, Vy đứng gần bàn ăn rồi tự ngồi xuống bậc cầu thang dưới cùng; Tùng vào từ cửa trước.
scenes.props: Giỏ trái cây mây, khăn lau bát, nồi đồ xôi nhôm, chiếc camera nhỏ màu trắng trên kệ bếp cao (đèn xanh nhấp nháy).
scenes.setting: Inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a ground-floor kitchen with a gas stove and a big aluminum sticky-rice steamer, a wooden dining table with low stools, a steep tiled staircase, a small family altar shelf, a small white home camera on a high kitchen shelf.

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Chị Thu ơi, em mang ít hoa quả sang chào chị cả, chị có nhà không ạ?
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot from the kitchen toward the front door, slow push-in
beats: The ground-floor kitchen of the tube house in soft afternoon light, the big aluminum sticky-rice steamer on the gas stove and the steep tiled staircase on the right.
@Vy steps in through the open front door in her crimson dress carrying a wicker basket of fruit, calling out sweetly into the house with raised eyebrows, her face and red lips clearly visible.
@Vy finishes calling and closes her lips, sets the fruit basket on the wooden dining table and runs one finger along its edge, inspecting the dust with a faint smirk.
clips.sfx: the alley outside, high heels on tiles, a wicker basket set down

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Em đến xem nhà một chút, sắp tới em với con trai anh Tùng sẽ về đây ở.
clips.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the stove toward the dining table, locked-off
beats: The wooden dining table with a wicker basket of fruit on it, the staircase and the small family altar shelf in the background.
@Vy stands by the table with one hand resting on her flat stomach, smiling sweetly as she speaks to @Thu, who stands by the stove holding a dish towel.
@Vy glances up at the staircase as if measuring the house, while @Thu stays rooted by the stove, her grip tightening on the towel.
clips.sfx: a moped passing in the alley, a dripping tap

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Đây là nhà của mẹ con tôi, mời cô về cho, tôi không muốn nói chuyện với cô.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on her face, slow push-in
beats: @Thu folds the dish towel and sets it on the stove, standing several steps away from @Vy.
@Thu speaks evenly to @Vy and points toward the open front door, her arm steady and her eyes cold.
@Thu keeps her arm pointed at the door with her jaw set, staying well apart from @Vy across the kitchen.
clips.sfx: the tap dripping, a car engine pulling into the alley outside

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Ối, đau quá, chị Thu ơi, sao chị nỡ làm thế với em, anh Tùng ơi, cứu con em với!
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot of the bottom of the staircase, locked-off
beats: The steep tiled staircase seen from the kitchen, the open front door bright behind it and a car's shadow sliding past the doorway outside.

@Vy glances quickly at the doorway, then clutches her stomach and lowers herself onto the bottom stair by herself, with nobody near her, wailing out loud as she sits, her face and lips clearly visible.
@Vy finishes crying out and closes her mouth, sitting hunched on the bottom step with one hand on her stomach and the other on the stair rail, peeking at the front door from under her lashes.
clips.sfx: a car door closing outside, the front gate creaking open

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Cô làm cái gì cô ấy thế hả? Cô ấy đang mang thai con của tôi đấy!
clips.camera: 35mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind her toward the doorway, slow handheld drift
beats: The bright front doorway of the tube house with the alley beyond, dust floating in the afternoon light.
@Tung strides in through the doorway in his charcoal suit and stops short, pointing at @Thu across the kitchen and shouting at her.
@Tung keeps his arm pointed at @Thu from several steps away, his face flushed, while @Thu stands motionless in the foreground by the stove with her hands at her sides.
clips.sfx: the front gate clanging open, quick footsteps on tiles

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Không ai tin mình cả, mình chẳng chạm vào cô ta, chỉ có trời biết, đất biết thôi.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on her face, slow tilt up to the shelf
beats: The kitchen in afternoon light, the gas stove and the sticky-rice steamer, a folded dish towel and an abandoned wicker fruit basket on the counter.
@Thu stands alone beside the stove with her arms hanging at her sides and whispers to herself, her eyes moving from the empty bottom stair to the open doorway, her face and lips clearly visible.

@Thu finishes whispering, closes her mouth and lifts her eyes upward, and the camera tilts up from her face to the small white home camera on the high kitchen shelf, its tiny green light blinking steadily.
clips.sfx: the tap dripping, a faint electronic beep

scenes.title: Mẹ Chồng Chọn Con Dâu
scenes.location: Tầng trệt nhà ống của Thu, buổi sáng một tuần sau.
scenes.axis: Máy quay ở phía bếp nhìn ra cửa trước; bàn ăn ở giữa, cầu thang bên phải, cửa trước sáng ở cuối hình; Na đứng cạnh túi đồ ở bậc cửa, bà Nhàn đi xuống từ cầu thang.
scenes.props: Đơn ly hôn (chữ mờ không đọc được), bút bi, thùng các-tông, túi vải đã đóng gói, chiếu cuộn, làn mây cũ và gậy tre của bà Nhàn.
scenes.setting: Inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a ground-floor kitchen with a gas stove and a big aluminum sticky-rice steamer, a wooden dining table with low stools, a steep tiled staircase, a small family altar shelf, a small white home camera on a high kitchen shelf.

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Đơn ly hôn tôi soạn sẵn rồi, cô ký vào đây cho xong, đừng bắt tôi phải chờ nữa.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot across the table, slow dolly across
beats: Morning light falls across the bare wooden dining table where a few printed pages with only faint unreadable lines of ink lie beside a cheap ballpoint pen.
@Tung steps up to the table in his charcoal suit, taps the pages with one finger and speaks curtly toward the kitchen, his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung finishes speaking and closes his mouth, drops the pen onto the last page and steps back with his hands in his pockets, his eyes turned away.
clips.sfx: a moped passing outside, paper rustling, the gas stove ticking as it cools

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Mười hai năm dọn cơm trên cái bàn này, em ký đây, em không lấy gì, chỉ xin nuôi con Na.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on her face and hands, slow push-in
beats: The dining table in morning light, the pages and the ballpoint pen waiting in front of an empty low stool.
@Thu sits down on the stool, signs the last page in one steady stroke and speaks calmly to @Tung, dry-eyed, her face and lips clearly visible.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, sets the pen down and squares the pages neatly with her back straight, while @Tung stands at the edge of the frame looking away.
clips.sfx: a pen scratching on paper, a deep slow breath

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Căn nhà này tôi xây, cô dọn đi trong tuần này, đừng để Vy phải nhìn thấy cô.
clips.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind her toward him, locked-off
beats: The foot of the tiled staircase beside the table, a stack of empty cardboard boxes leaning against the wall.
@Tung stands by the staircase with his hands in his suit pockets and speaks coldly down at @Thu, who stays seated at the table.
@Tung picks up the signed pages, folds them into his jacket and turns his face away from @Thu.
clips.sfx: paper rustling, a car horn in the alley

clips.speaker: @Na
clips.line: Bà ơi, bà xách làn đi đâu thế ạ? Bà cũng dọn đi với mẹ con con thật ạ?
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot toward the front door, slow pan
beats: The front doorway of the tube house, two packed cloth bags and a rolled straw mat waiting on the threshold.

@BaNhan comes down the last stairs with an old rattan basket on her arm and her bamboo walking stick, as @Na, standing by the packed bags, looks up at her and speaks, the girl's face and lips clearly visible.
@Na finishes speaking and closes her mouth, while @BaNhan walks slowly to the doorway and stands beside her granddaughter, pulling her brown cardigan tight, her chin raised.
clips.sfx: slow footsteps on the stairs, a walking stick tapping on tiles

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Mẹ đi theo con dâu, con trai tôi chết từ hôm nó bỏ vợ bỏ con rồi.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on her face, slow push-in
beats: The bright doorway with the packed bags on the threshold, a strip of morning sun across the tiled floor.
@BaNhan stands in the doorway leaning on her stick and speaks to @Tung without looking at him, her voice shaking but her chin high.
@BaNhan turns her face toward the alley, while @Tung stands a few steps behind her with his mouth closed and his hands hanging.
clips.sfx: the alley waking up, a rooster far away

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Đi hết thì càng tốt, nhà cửa từ nay sạch sẽ, yên tĩnh, nhưng sao lại vắng thế này nhỉ?
clips.camera: 28mm medium-wide high-angle shot from the stairs, slow crane down
beats: The empty ground floor seen from above, the bare dining table, the cold stove and the sticky-rice steamer with no steam.
@Tung stands alone in the middle of the kitchen in his charcoal suit, looking slowly around at the bare walls and muttering to himself, his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung finishes speaking and closes his mouth, rooted to the spot with his hands in his pockets, the open front door bright and empty behind him.
clips.sfx: silence, a faint echo from the alley, a refrigerator humming

scenes.title: Căn Phòng Trọ Mười Mét Vuông
scenes.location: Phòng trọ mười mét vuông trong xóm trọ chật chội ở Hà Nội, buổi tối mưa.
scenes.axis: Máy quay từ phía cửa nhìn vào; giường gỗ bên trái sát tường, bàn gấp bên phải dưới cửa sổ song sắt, chậu nhôm hứng dột ở giữa phòng.
scenes.props: Chậu nhôm hứng dột, nồi đồ xôi, túi vải, gói khăn tay đựng vàng của bà Nhàn, bức tranh sáp màu của Na, bóng đèn vàng, chiếu cói.
scenes.setting: A tiny rented room in a crowded Hà Nội boarding alley at night: a single wooden bed, a folding table, a small barred window, a hot plate, an aluminum basin catching drips from the leaking ceiling, a bare yellow bulb.

clips.speaker: @Na
clips.line: Mẹ ơi, phòng mình bé tí thế này à? Mưa dột cả vào chậu rồi này mẹ.
clips.camera: 24mm wide shot from the doorway, slow push-in
beats: A tiny rented room at night lit by a bare yellow bulb, a single wooden bed against the wall, packed cloth bags on the floor and rain dripping from a dark ceiling stain into an aluminum basin.
@Na steps into the room close to the camera in her school clothes, hugging a small cloth bag, looks up at the dripping ceiling and calls back over her shoulder, her face and lips clearly visible.
@Na finishes speaking and closes her mouth, crouching beside the aluminum basin to watch another drop land and ripple the water under the bare bulb.
clips.sfx: rain on a tin roof, water dripping into a metal basin

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Phòng bé nhưng ấm, mẹ lau một tí là sạch ngay, coi như mình chuyển nhà thôi con ạ.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot, slow pan following her
beats: The cramped room with a damp concrete floor, the big aluminum sticky-rice steamer standing beside a folding table.
@Thu mops the wet floor with quick strong strokes and speaks warmly toward the doorway with a small smile, her face and lips clearly visible.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, sets the sticky-rice steamer neatly in the corner and wipes her hands on her apron, looking around the room with her chin up.
clips.sfx: a mop on wet concrete, rain on the roof, the basin dripping

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Con ạ, mẹ còn ít vàng dành dụm, con cầm lấy mà mở một quán xôi cho tử tế.
clips.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the younger woman toward the mother, locked-off
beats: The edge of the wooden bed under the bare bulb, a small knotted handkerchief bundle resting on the thin blanket.
@BaNhan sits on the bed and holds out the small knotted handkerchief bundle to @Thu with both trembling hands, speaking softly.
@BaNhan holds the bundle out toward @Thu and nods insistently, her wrinkled eyes wet.
clips.sfx: rain on the roof, the basin dripping

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Mẹ giữ lấy mà dưỡng già, con còn đôi bàn tay, con sẽ làm lại từ đầu mẹ ạ.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on the two pairs of hands, slow tilt up to her face
beats: @Thu kneels beside the bed and gently folds @BaNhan's fingers back over the handkerchief bundle.
@Thu speaks softly to @BaNhan, holding her mother-in-law's hands in her own rough palms.
@Thu smiles through wet eyes and rests her forehead briefly against @BaNhan's knuckles.
clips.sfx: rain softening, the basin dripping

clips.speaker: @Na
clips.line: Đây là bà, đây là mẹ, đây là con, nắm tay nhau thật chặt, không ai bỏ ai.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot across the folding table, slow dolly-in
beats: The folding table under the bare yellow bulb, an open exercise book and a crayon drawing of three figures holding hands, with no words on the page.
@Na sits at the folding table in her school clothes, touching each figure in the drawing with a red crayon and whispering to herself, her face and lips clearly visible under the yellow bulb.
@Na finishes whispering and closes her mouth, smoothing the drawing flat and looking at it with a small closed-mouth smile.
clips.sfx: a crayon scratching on paper, rain on the roof

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Từ nay không phải thức chờ ai về nữa, mình ngủ một giấc cho thật ngon thôi.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on her face on the mat, slow push-in
beats: Faint streetlight from the small barred window falls across a straw mat and a thin blanket on the floor of the dark room, the bulb switched off.
@Thu lies down on her side on the straw mat, fully clothed, pulls the thin blanket up and whispers to herself with a faint smile, her face and lips visible in the streetlight.
@Thu finishes whispering, closes her mouth and her eyes, and sinks into a deep sleep with slow even breathing, one hand resting open on the mat.
clips.sfx: light rain, slow steady breathing, a distant moped

scenes.title: Chữ Ký Định Mệnh
scenes.location: Nhà cũ của Thu (Vy dọn vào), văn phòng giám đốc của Tùng và hầm xe dưới tòa nhà.
scenes.axis: Văn phòng: máy quay phía trước bàn làm việc trắng, Tùng ngồi ghế da bên trái, Vy đứng bên phải; hầm xe: máy quay nhìn qua kính chắn gió, Khải ngồi ghế lái bên trái, Vy ghế phụ bên phải.
scenes.props: Giấy ủy quyền (chữ mờ không đọc được), bút vàng, bìa hồ sơ trắng, quầy rượu gỗ sẫm, rèm nhung đỏ, xe sang đen không logo.
scenes.setting: A modern glass-walled director's office high in a Hà Nội tower: a large white desk with a family photo frame, a black leather chair, an architectural model of a residential tower, the city skyline beyond the windows.

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Dọn hết nồi niêu của bà vợ cũ đi, nhà này giờ có quầy rượu với rèm nhung đỏ rồi.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot, slow pan across the kitchen
beats: The ground-floor kitchen of the tube house half-emptied, the big aluminum sticky-rice steamer on the floor beside a new dark-wood bar counter, deep red velvet curtains hanging over the window.

@Vy stands in the middle of the kitchen in her crimson dress, pointing one manicured finger at the steamer and speaking sharply to the two workers in grey overalls, her face and red lips clearly visible.
@Vy finishes speaking and closes her lips into a smile, running her hand along the new bar counter as the two workers carry the big aluminum steamer out the front door.
clips.sfx: furniture scraping, a steamer lid clanging, high heels on tiles
clips.setting: Inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a ground-floor kitchen with a gas stove and a big aluminum sticky-rice steamer, a wooden dining table with low stools, a steep tiled staircase, a small family altar shelf, a small white home camera on a high kitchen shelf.
clips.extras: two workers in grey overalls carrying kitchen things out the front door

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Anh ký vào đây cho em, giấy ủy quyền thôi mà, để em lo hết giấy tờ cho con.
clips.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind his chair toward her, locked-off
beats: The large white desk in the glass office, a thin stack of documents with faint unreadable lines and a gold pen laid neatly on top.
@Vy leans over the desk beside @Tung's leather chair, slides the documents toward him and speaks sweetly, tapping the bottom of the page with a red fingernail, her face and lips clearly visible.
@Vy finishes speaking and straightens up, smiling down at @Tung with closed lips, one hand resting lightly on the back of his chair.
clips.sfx: papers sliding on a desk, the air conditioner humming, distant city traffic

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Em lo thì anh yên tâm, anh ký luôn, mấy cái giấy tờ này anh chả buồn đọc.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on his face and hands, slow tilt down
beats: @Tung picks up the gold pen with a relaxed grin, glancing up at @Vy.
@Tung speaks lightly to @Vy as he signs page after page without reading, his pen moving fast.
@Tung caps the gold pen and slides the signed stack back across the desk, leaning back in his chair with a satisfied sigh.
clips.sfx: a pen scratching quickly, pages flipping

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Một chữ ký thôi, cả công ty lẫn căn nhà lão vừa đuổi vợ đi, giờ đều nằm trong tay mình.
clips.camera: 100mm extreme close-up, slow tilt up from the folder to her lips and eyes
beats: The signed documents lying on the white desk, faint unreadable lines of ink and a fresh dark scrawl at the bottom of the page.
@Vy's red-nailed fingers close a slim white folder over the documents and lift it to her chest as she whispers to herself, her red lips moving clearly in the frame.
@Vy finishes whispering and her red lips close and curl into a cold smile, her sharp winged eyes narrowing above the white folder.
clips.sfx: a folder snapping shut, the air conditioner humming

clips.speaker: @Khai
clips.line: Ký mỗi tờ giấy mà đi lâu thế, lão Tùng mà nghi ngờ thì hỏng hết cả kế hoạch.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up through the windshield, slow push-in
beats: A dim underground car park, a black luxury sedan with no badge parked in a row of concrete pillars, the elevator doors glowing in the distance.
@Khai sits behind the wheel of the black sedan, drumming his fingers on the steering wheel and muttering to himself, his face and lips clearly visible through the windshield.
@Khai finishes speaking and closes his mouth, leaning forward with his eyes on the distant elevator doors as they slide open, a sly half-smile spreading under his thin moustache.
clips.sfx: fingers drumming on leather, a distant elevator chime, an echoing car park
clips.setting: Inside a black luxury sedan with no badge parked in a dim underground car park, the elevator doors glowing in the distance.

clips.speaker: @Khai
clips.line: Xong rồi chứ em? Ba tháng nữa mình rút hết tiền, bay ra nước ngoài sống như vua.
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot from the back seat, locked-off
beats: Inside the black luxury sedan in the dim car park, the passenger door swinging open and the elevator doors glowing beyond the windshield.
@Vy slides into the passenger seat holding the slim white folder, and @Khai turns to her and speaks with a sly grin.
@Khai taps the white folder in her lap with one finger, while @Vy settles back in her sunglasses with a satisfied closed smile.
clips.sfx: a car door shutting, an engine starting, an echoing car park
clips.setting: Inside a black luxury sedan with no badge parked in a dim underground car park, the elevator doors glowing in the distance.

scenes.title: Quán Xôi Của Thu
scenes.location: Quán xôi nhỏ của Thu ở một góc phố cổ Hà Nội, trước bình minh.
scenes.axis: Quầy gỗ bên trái màn hình, vỉa hè và hàng người mua bên phải; máy quay đặt trong quán nhìn ra phố.
scenes.props: Nồi xôi lớn bốc khói, những gói xôi lá chuối, lạt tre, quầy gỗ cũ.
scenes.setting: Before dawn at Thu's small sticky-rice shop on a Hà Nội old-quarter street: a worn wooden counter, rows of banana-leaf parcels, big steaming pots, warm yellow light spilling onto the pavement.

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
