clips.line: Sáu tháng nay ngày nào con cũng mở quán từ lúc trời còn tối, không mệt hả con?
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot from the pavement, slow crane down to the shop doorway
beats: A dark old-quarter street before dawn, yellow streetlamps glowing on mossy walls as warm light and thick steam spill from the small sticky-rice shop onto the empty pavement.
@Thu lifts a big pot lid behind the worn wooden counter while @BaNhan steps into the lit doorway with her carved bamboo walking stick and speaks fondly to her, face and lips clearly visible.
@BaNhan finishes speaking and closes her mouth, shaking her head with a soft smile, as @Thu glances up at her through the rising steam.
clips.sfx: steam hissing from big pots, a walking stick tapping the doorstep, roosters crowing in the alley

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Không mệt đâu mẹ, quán mình chẳng có biển hiệu gì, chỉ có nồi xôi ngon, mở muộn là khách phải chờ.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on Thu behind the counter, slow push-in
beats: @Thu scoops glossy sticky rice onto a fresh banana leaf and answers @BaNhan with a gentle smile, her face and lips clearly visible in the warm steam.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, folding the banana leaf into a neat parcel with quick practiced hands.
@Thu sets the parcel on the rows along the counter, her calm smile glowing gold in the steam as @BaNhan nods softly at the edge of the frame.
clips.sfx: steam rushing, banana leaves rustling, a wooden spoon scraping the pot

clips.speaker: @Na
clips.line: Hàng dài đến tận đầu phố rồi, cô đi xe cả tiếng chỉ để mua xôi mẹ cháu thật ạ?
clips.camera: 50mm medium tracking shot along the queue
beats: The old-quarter pavement in front of the glowing shop, parked mopeds lining the curb under yellow streetlamps and the first pale blue light above the rooftops.
@Na walks along the long queue carrying a tray of banana-leaf parcels, stops beside the young woman in a work blazer and speaks up to her with wide eyes, her lips clearly visible.
@Na closes her mouth and grins as the young woman nods, the queue stretching behind them all the way back to the corner of the street.
clips.sfx: shuffling footsteps, mopeds idling, steam hissing in the distance
clips.extras: a long queue of office workers and students waiting under the streetlamps, a young woman in a work blazer at its front

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Buộc lạt chặt tay vào cháu, nhà mình mất nhà mất cửa, nhưng còn nhau là còn tất cả.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up two-shot from table height, slow lateral slide
beats: A low wooden table at the back of the shop piled with fresh green banana leaves, a bundle of bamboo strings and a small stool in the warm light.
@BaNhan sits on the low stool folding banana leaves around sticky rice and speaks warmly to @Na, who kneels beside her wrapping a parcel with a bamboo string.
@BaNhan closes her mouth with crinkled smiling eyes as @Na holds up a neatly finished parcel, both of them beaming in the warm lamplight.
clips.sfx: banana leaves crinkling, bamboo strings tightening, steam in the background

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Xôi hôm nay hết sớm rồi, mai cả nhà quay lại, em để phần trước cho nhé!
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot from the pavement facing the counter, slow push-in
beats: The worn wooden counter with an empty steaming pot and a few last banana-leaf parcels, warm light falling onto the pavement.
@Thu leans over the counter and speaks warmly to a few customers holding banana-leaf parcels, tilting the empty pot to show it.
@Thu presses her palms together in a small apologetic bow, smiling, as the customers nod and step back onto the pavement.
clips.sfx: steam fading, mopeds passing, a ladle tapping the empty pot
clips.extras: a few customers holding banana-leaf parcels

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Người ta chê đôi bàn tay này thô ráp, giờ chính nó nuôi cả bà, cả con mình đấy.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on Thu behind the counter, slow push-in
beats: @Thu wipes her work-roughened hands on her dark-green cloth apron, looks down at them and speaks softly to herself, her face and lips clearly visible.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, turning her rough, rice-flecked palms up in front of her and studying them in the warm light.
@Thu rests her hands flat on the wooden counter and lifts her face, calm and upright, her eyes bright in the rising steam and the first light of dawn.
clips.sfx: steam settling, a distant temple bell, birds waking in the alley

scenes.title: Công Ty Rỗng Ruột
scenes.location: Phòng giám đốc vách kính trên tầng cao, công ty xây dựng của Tùng; cuối cảnh là một con phố Hà Nội lúc chạng vạng.
scenes.axis: Bàn trắng ở giữa, cửa kính và đường chân trời phía sau Tùng; cửa ra vào bên phải màn hình.
scenes.props: Tập hồ sơ, giấy chuyển tiền chỉ có dòng mực mờ, điện thoại, mô hình tòa nhà, khung ảnh gia đình úp mặt.
scenes.setting: A modern glass-walled director's office high in a Hà Nội tower: a large white desk with a family photo frame, a black leather chair, an architectural model of a residential tower, the city skyline beyond the windows.

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Sao lại hủy hợp đồng? Tuần này đã ba bên hủy rồi, anh nói rõ lý do cho tôi!
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot, slow dolly across the office
beats: The glass-walled director's office in cold morning light, loose papers covered in faint unreadable lines scattered across the large white desk beside the architectural model of a residential tower.
@Tung strides in from the door holding his phone to his ear, its screen turned away, and speaks sharply into it, his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung finishes speaking and closes his mouth, lowering the phone and staring at the scattered papers, one roof piece of the tower model sitting crooked on its top floor.
clips.sfx: air conditioning hum, a phone ringing unanswered in the next room, footsteps on the carpet

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Chị nói sao? Tài khoản công ty mình chỉ còn có vài trăm nghìn đồng thôi à?
clips.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the accountant onto Tùng, slow push-in
beats: The large white desk with a black leather chair, a closed laptop and a framed family photo of Thu, Tùng and Na lying face down.
@Tung sits in the black leather chair, flips open the thick folder the accountant has set before him and speaks sharply up at her, his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung closes his mouth and stares at pages of faint unreadable figures, his hand frozen on the paper, as the accountant lowers her eyes.
clips.sfx: paper sliding on the desk, the accountant's shallow breathing, the city hum
clips.extras: a middle-aged woman accountant in a grey cardigan holding a folder

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Tiền đâu hết rồi? Ai rút hết tiền của công ty tôi? Gọi Vy lên đây ngay!
clips.camera: 35mm close-up on Tùng, slow drift
beats: @Tung rises from the black leather chair with the open folder in his hand as the accountant in the grey cardigan steps back a pace.
@Tung shouts across the desk toward the accountant, his face flushed and a vein standing out on his temple.
@Tung drops the folder onto the desk and leans on its edge with both hands, breathing hard, as the accountant hurries out.
clips.sfx: the folder landing on the desk, heavy breathing, a door closing
clips.extras: a middle-aged woman accountant in a grey cardigan holding a folder

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Lệnh chuyển tiền nào cũng có chữ ký ủy quyền của Vy, người mà mình tin nhất đời.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot across the desk, slow rack focus from the slips to his face
beats: A stack of transfer slips on the white desk in sharp focus, each covered in faint unreadable lines and the same blue ink scrawl at the bottom.
Focus racks to @Tung leaning over the desk behind the slips, sliding a finger from one blue scrawl to the next as he mutters to himself, his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung closes his mouth, lets the slips drop onto the desk and slowly draws his phone from his jacket pocket.
clips.sfx: paper rustling, a long silence, distant traffic far below

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Nghe máy đi Vy, anh gọi em hai mươi cuộc rồi, sao chỉ toàn thuê bao thế này?
clips.camera: 85mm close-up by the window, slow arc
beats: @Tung presses the phone to his ear, its screen turned away, turns toward the floor-to-ceiling window and speaks hoarsely into it, his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung finishes speaking and closes his mouth, lowers the phone, taps its softly glowing screen turned away from the camera and lifts it back to his ear.
@Tung lets the phone drop to his side and leans his forehead against the cold glass, his breath fogging the window above the grey skyline.
clips.sfx: a phone ringing out again and again, a flat automated tone, the hum of the city below

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Công ty mất rồi, tiền cũng mất, Vy cũng chẳng thấy đâu, giờ mình biết đi đâu đây?
clips.camera: 50mm medium tracking shot along the pavement
beats: A busy Hà Nội street at dusk, rush-hour mopeds streaming past far beyond a row of parked bikes, neon shop lights flickering on above the pavement.
@Tung walks slowly along the pavement in his creased charcoal-grey suit, his shirt collar askew, muttering to himself with his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung stops beside a lamppost, closes his mouth and stares blankly at the blur of distant headlights, his arms hanging loose at his sides.
clips.sfx: roaring rush-hour traffic, horns, a buzzing neon tube
clips.setting: Dusk on a busy Hà Nội street, rush-hour mopeds, neon shop lights flickering on.

scenes.title: Sau Lớp Kính Quán Cà Phê
scenes.time_label: Tối mưa, quán cà phê quen của Vy (18:00–19:00)
scenes.location: Vỉa hè trước quán cà phê sang trọng quen của Vy trong đêm mưa, và bàn góc bên trong quán.
scenes.axis: Ngoài trời: Tùng đứng trên vỉa hè bên trái, cửa kính quán ở giữa. Trong quán: bàn góc cạnh cửa sổ, Vy ngồi ghế nhung bên phải, Tùng đứng bên trái.
scenes.props: Cửa kính mưa chảy, hai ly nước ép cao, bàn đá, túi xách trắng nhỏ của Vy.
scenes.setting: Rainy night on the pavement outside an upscale café, warm light glowing through tall rain-streaked windows.

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Đèn quán quen của Vy vẫn sáng, gọi cả ngày không nghe máy, chắc cô ấy ngồi trong này.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot along the wet pavement, slow push-in toward the glowing window
beats: Rain falls through the yellow glow of a streetlamp onto the empty wet pavement outside an upscale café, warm light glowing through its tall rain-streaked windows.
@Tung walks into frame in his soaked suit, stops in front of the glowing window and murmurs to himself, rain running down his face and his lips clearly visible.
@Tung closes his mouth and steps closer to the glass, then goes rigid, his eyes fixed on something inside the café.
clips.sfx: steady rain on the pavement, water gurgling in a gutter, a car hissing past far away

clips.speaker: @Khai
clips.line: Cụng ly đi em, lão Tùng mất sạch cơ nghiệp rồi mà vẫn đinh ninh sắp có con trai đấy.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up two-shot past the brass lamps, slow lateral slide
beats: A corner table of the upscale café, a marble top with two tall glasses of fruit juice, brass lamps glowing and rain streaking the window behind.
@Vy sits in a velvet armchair resting her head on @Khai's shoulder as he lifts his glass toward hers and speaks to her with a sly grin, his lips clearly visible.
@Khai closes his mouth and they clink glasses, @Vy smiling widely with one hand resting on her flat stomach, her small white handbag on the marble table.
clips.sfx: glasses clinking, soft rain on the window, a coffee machine hissing
clips.setting: An upscale café at night: velvet armchairs, brass lamps, marble tables, rain-streaked floor-to-ceiling windows facing the street.

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Nó tựa đầu vào vai thằng khác, cái bụng vẫn phẳng lì, thế mà bảo đang có con với mình.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot through the rain, slow push-in
beats: The rain-streaked café window from outside, warm blurred light behind the glass and rain dripping from the awning edge.
@Tung stands on the wet pavement facing the window, rain soaking his hair and suit, and speaks hoarsely to himself, his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung closes his mouth and stands motionless in the rain, water running down his face, his jaw clenched and his hands hanging open at his sides.
clips.sfx: rain pouring, distant thunder, water dripping from an awning

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Vy, gã này là ai? Còn đứa con của anh, em giải thích cho anh nghe đi!
clips.camera: 35mm over-the-shoulder shot across the table, slow push-in
beats: The corner café table under brass lamps, two half-finished glasses of fruit juice on the marble top beside a small white handbag.
@Tung stands dripping wet beside the table and speaks hoarsely down at @Vy, who stays seated in the velvet armchair an arm's length away.
@Vy leans back in the armchair, crosses her legs and looks up at @Tung with a slow, unbothered smile.
clips.sfx: rain dripping from his clothes onto the floor, a hushed café, a cup set down on a saucer
clips.setting: An upscale café at night: velvet armchairs, brass lamps, marble tables, rain-streaked floor-to-ceiling windows facing the street.

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Con nào hả anh? Que thử thai em mua mười nghìn ngoài hiệu thuốc đấy, anh ngây thơ thật.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on Vy, slow push-in
beats: @Vy tilts her head and looks up at @Tung with a mocking half-smile, one hand resting flat on her stomach.
@Vy speaks lightly and sharply, tapping her flat stomach twice with her red-nailed fingertips.
@Vy lifts her glass and takes a slow sip, her feline eyes never leaving @Tung's face.
clips.sfx: ice clinking in a glass, rain on the window
clips.setting: An upscale café at night: velvet armchairs, brass lamps, marble tables, rain-streaked floor-to-ceiling windows facing the street.

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Anh tưởng em yêu cái bụng phệ của anh à? Em yêu tiền của anh thôi, giờ tiền hết rồi.
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot, slow pan following her
beats: @Vy rises from the velvet armchair, slings her small white handbag over her shoulder and speaks coolly to @Tung from an arm's length away.
@Vy finishes with a cold little shrug, turns on her heel and walks toward the café door, heels clicking on the floor.
@Tung stands alone and dripping beside the empty table, staring after her as the glass door swings shut.
clips.sfx: heels clicking, the café door swinging shut, rain rushing in for a moment
clips.setting: An upscale café at night: velvet armchairs, brass lamps, marble tables, rain-streaked floor-to-ceiling windows facing the street.

scenes.title: Căn Nhà Bị Niêm Phong
scenes.time_label: Đêm mưa đến rạng sáng, trước cổng nhà cũ (19:00–20:00)
scenes.location: Con ngõ nhỏ trước cổng sắt căn nhà ống cũ của gia đình, đêm mưa đến rạng sáng.
scenes.axis: Cổng sắt ở giữa màn hình, bậc cửa đá phía dưới; đèn đường bên trái; đầu ngõ ra phố ở phía máy quay.
scenes.props: Giấy niêm phong dán ngang cổng (chỉ có dòng chữ mờ không đọc được), điện thoại của Tùng, bậc cửa đá.
scenes.setting: Rainy night in a narrow Hà Nội alley outside a closed steel gate of a tube house, a paper seal stuck across the gate, a single streetlamp.

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Ngân hàng niêm phong nhà rồi sao? Vy đem căn nhà này đi thế chấp từ bao giờ thế này?
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot down the alley, slow push-in toward the gate
beats: A narrow rain-soaked alley at night, a single streetlamp lighting puddles and a closed steel gate with a long paper seal of faint unreadable lines pasted across it.
@Tung walks up to the sealed gate in his soaked suit, stares at the paper seal and speaks hoarsely to himself, his face and lips clearly visible under the streetlamp.
@Tung closes his mouth and lays one palm flat on the wet iron bars beside the seal, rain beading on the paper and dripping from the gate.
clips.sfx: heavy rain, water rushing in a gutter, a dog barking far away

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Giờ thì chẳng còn ai để gọi nữa, vợ con, mẹ già, mình tự tay đuổi đi cả rồi.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up from step level, slow drift
beats: The worn stone doorstep below the sealed steel gate, rainwater pooling on it under the yellow streetlamp.
@Tung sinks into frame onto the wet doorstep, his phone hanging loosely from one hand, and murmurs to himself with rain dripping from his hair, his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung closes his mouth and sits hunched with his forearms on his knees, staring at the dark phone in his hand.
clips.sfx: rain pattering on fabric, the gate dripping, distant thunder

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Cái camera bếp Thu cài cho mình ngày xưa, không biết đoạn ghi hình cũ còn lưu không.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot, slow push-in
beats: @Tung lifts the phone and wipes the rain off it with his thumb, the screen turned away from the camera, speaking quietly to himself with his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung closes his mouth and taps the phone; a pale glow lights up his wet face while the screen stays turned away from the camera.
@Tung holds the phone closer, shielding it from the rain with his other hand, his eyes narrowing as his thumb scrolls.
clips.sfx: rain on the phone, soft taps, thunder rolling

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Chiều hôm ấy đây rồi, Vy tự ngồi xuống cầu thang, tự ôm bụng, tự kêu lên mà.
clips.camera: 100mm extreme close-up on his face, static
beats: Raindrops falling past the yellow streetlamp in a dark blur, a faint pale glow trembling in the foreground.
@Tung's face fills the frame, lit only by the cold glow of the phone below the frame, his eyes tracking something small as he whispers to himself, his lips clearly visible.
@Tung closes his mouth, his eyes stop moving and his breath catches, his lips trembling.
clips.sfx: rain, a sharp intake of breath, distant thunder

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Thu chưa từng chạm vào cô ta, thế mà mình quát vào mặt vợ mười hai năm, chẳng một lời xin lỗi.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow pull back
beats: @Tung lowers the glowing phone onto his knee, stares at the rain-soaked alley and speaks hoarsely to himself, his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung finishes speaking, closes his mouth and presses the back of his hand against it, his shoulders starting to shake under the soaked suit.
@Tung bows his head over his knees on the doorstep, the phone's glow fading out beside him in the rain.
clips.sfx: rain intensifying, a choked breath, water dripping from the gate

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Trời sáng rồi, phải ra đồn công an tố cáo Vy, ít ra cũng làm được một việc tử tế.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot facing him in the alley, slow crane up
beats: Grey dawn light creeps into the narrow alley as the rain eases to a fine drizzle, the streetlamp still glowing beside the sealed gate.
@Tung rises into frame from the doorstep below, wipes his face with his sleeve and speaks quietly to himself with a set jaw, his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung closes his mouth, pockets his phone and walks away down the wet alley toward the brightening street, his back straight.
clips.sfx: light drizzle, footsteps on wet concrete, the first moped starting in the distance
clips.setting: Grey dawn in the same narrow Hà Nội alley outside the sealed steel gate, the rain easing to a drizzle, the streetlamp still on.

scenes.title: Chuyến Bay Không Cất Cánh
scenes.time_label: Sáng, sảnh ga đi sân bay (20:00–21:00)
scenes.location: Sảnh ga đi của một sân bay quốc tế, buổi sáng.
scenes.axis: Quầy làm thủ tục ở cuối hình; Vy và Khải đi từ trái sang phải; công an tiến tới từ phía quầy.
scenes.props: Vali kéo vỏ cứng, kính râm, túi xách trắng nhỏ của Vy, tờ lệnh bắt và thẻ lên máy bay (chỉ có dòng chữ mờ).
scenes.setting: A bright modern airport departure hall: polished stone floor, check-in counters, tall glass walls, travelers with suitcases in the distance.

clips.speaker: @Khai
clips.line: Tiền chuyển sang tài khoản nước ngoài hết chưa em? Hôm nay bay rồi, không được sót đồng nào.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot, slow crane down through the hall
beats: A bright modern airport departure hall, morning sun pouring through the tall glass walls onto the polished stone floor as a white airliner rolls slowly along the runway beyond.
@Khai and @Vy walk into frame wearing dark sunglasses, each pulling a hard-shell suitcase, and @Khai leans toward @Vy speaking low, his lips clearly visible.
@Khai closes his mouth with a sly half-smile as @Vy smirks behind her sunglasses, the two of them strolling on toward the check-in counters.
clips.sfx: airport hall echo, a distant jet engine, suitcase wheels rolling on stone

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Hết rồi anh, cả công ty lẫn căn nhà của lão, giờ chỉ việc lên máy bay thôi.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up two-shot tracking alongside them
beats: @Vy slips her hand into @Khai's as they walk and answers him with an easy smile, her red lips clearly visible below her dark sunglasses.
@Vy finishes speaking and closes her mouth, and the pair stride hand in hand across the gleaming floor with relaxed shoulders.
@Vy swings her small white handbag at her side as @Khai squeezes her hand, the check-in counters drawing nearer behind them.
clips.sfx: suitcase wheels rolling on stone, heels clicking, a soft chime echoing in the hall

clips.speaker: @Khai
clips.line: Qua được cửa này là mình giàu cả đời em ạ, lão Tùng giờ chắc đang ngồi khóc ở đâu đó.
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot, slow backward dolly
beats: @Khai leans his head toward @Vy as they walk, sliding his sunglasses down his nose.
@Khai speaks with a sly grin, his voice low, as @Vy smirks behind her sunglasses.
@Khai slides his sunglasses back up and strolls on toward the counters beside @Vy, his suitcase rolling behind him.
clips.sfx: suitcase wheels, footsteps echoing, a distant jet engine

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Sao công an lại đứng chờ ngay quầy thủ tục, tờ giấy kia không lẽ là lệnh bắt mình?
clips.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder shot onto Vy from the counter side, slow push-in
beats: The check-in counters in bright morning light, the polished stone floor stretching empty in front of them.
@Vy stops short with her suitcase as the two officers walk calmly toward her, one holding up a paper with faint unreadable lines, and she murmurs to herself, her lips clearly visible.
@Vy closes her mouth and slowly lowers her sunglasses, her fingers going still on the suitcase handle as the officers stop a calm step away.
clips.sfx: suitcase wheels stopping, measured footsteps on stone, the hall falling quiet
clips.extras: two police officers in dark-green uniforms walking calmly toward her

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Các anh nhầm người rồi, tôi là vợ giám đốc, các anh có biết tôi là ai không?
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on Vy, slow push-in
beats: @Vy pulls off her sunglasses and lifts her chin at the two police officers standing a calm step away from her.
@Vy speaks sharply, one hand tightening on the strap of her small white handbag as she takes a half step back.
@Vy goes silent, her red lips pressed together and her eyes darting toward the exit while the officers stand still and wait.
clips.sfx: a hushed hall, a distant chime, a heel scraping the stone floor
clips.extras: two police officers in dark-green uniforms walking calmly toward her

clips.speaker: @Khai
clips.line: Thôi, hết đường chạy rồi, các anh cứ làm việc đi, tôi xin tự giác đi theo.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot, slow push-in
beats: A stretch of polished stone floor near the counters, a hard-shell suitcase standing upright in a pool of sunlight.
@Khai lets go of the suitcase handle and speaks quietly to the police officer standing calmly a step away, his sly grin gone and his lips clearly visible.
@Khai closes his mouth and holds out both wrists toward the officer as a boarding pass with faint unreadable print slips from his fingers onto the cold stone floor.
clips.sfx: the suitcase settling on its wheels, a hushed hall, paper landing on stone
clips.extras: a police officer in a dark-green uniform standing calmly a step away from him

scenes.title: Gói Xôi Lúc Bình Minh
scenes.location: Quán xôi của Thu ở phố cổ, trước bình minh, một tuần sau.
scenes.axis: Quầy gỗ và Thu bên trái màn hình, vỉa hè và Tùng bên phải; máy quay đặt ngang quầy.
scenes.props: Gói xôi lá chuối nóng buộc lạt, nồi xôi bốc khói, quầy gỗ cũ.
scenes.setting: Before dawn at Thu's small sticky-rice shop on a Hà Nội old-quarter street: a worn wooden counter, rows of banana-leaf parcels, big steaming pots, warm yellow light spilling onto the pavement.

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Quán của Thu đây rồi, mình còn mặt mũi nào mà xếp hàng mua xôi của cô ấy nữa.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up from the far end of the pavement, slow rack focus from the glowing shop to his face
beats: The old-quarter street before dawn, the sticky-rice shop glowing soft and warm at the far end of a dark wet pavement, steam rising into the lamplight through a light drizzle.
@Tung steps into the foreground, gaunt in a creased rain-stained suit, and focus racks to his hollow face as he murmurs to himself, his lips clearly visible.
@Tung closes his mouth and stands still in the drizzle, his sunken eyes fixed on the warm light of the distant shop.
clips.sfx: light drizzle, steam hissing far away, a moped passing in the distance

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Anh Tùng? Sao anh gầy rộc thế này, quần áo nhàu nát, anh đứng ngoài ấy từ bao giờ?
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot across the counter, slow push-in
beats: The worn wooden counter of the shop, banana-leaf parcels stacked beside a steaming pot under a warm bulb.
@Thu looks up from wrapping a parcel as @Tung steps up to the counter in his creased suit, and she speaks to him in a low, steady voice, her lips clearly visible.
@Thu closes her mouth and they look at each other across the counter in silence, the steam drifting between them.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, drizzle on the awning, a parcel set down on wood

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Thu ơi, anh sai rồi, anh mù quáng, em cho anh về với mẹ con em được không?
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on Tùng over Thu's shoulder, slow push-in
beats: @Tung rests both hands on the edge of the wooden counter, his eyes red-rimmed and wet.
@Tung speaks to @Thu in a cracked, pleading voice, leaning toward her across the counter.
@Tung's voice gives out and he lowers his gaze to the steaming pot, his hands still clinging to the counter edge.
clips.sfx: steam, drizzle, his unsteady breathing

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Gói xôi này em mời anh, còn cơm nhà, chính anh đã tự tay bỏ đi rồi.
clips.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder shot onto Thu, static
beats: @Thu wraps a fresh scoop of hot sticky rice in a banana leaf, ties it with a bamboo string and begins to speak as she holds it out across the counter.
@Thu speaks to @Tung calmly and evenly, setting the warm banana-leaf parcel into his open hands without letting her fingers linger.
@Thu straightens behind the counter with her hands folded on her apron, her face steady and her eyes dry.
clips.sfx: banana leaf crinkling, steam hissing, drizzle

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Xôi vẫn nóng như ngày xưa em đồ cho anh, thế mà anh từng chê xôi với chả xôi.
clips.camera: 50mm medium low-angle shot from the pavement, slow crane down
beats: The wet pavement in front of the shop glistening under warm light spilling from the counter, steam drifting over the curb.
@Tung sinks to his knees on the wet pavement, holding the warm banana-leaf parcel against his chest, and speaks hoarsely to it, his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung closes his mouth and bows his head over the parcel, tears dropping onto the green banana leaf as the drizzle falls around him.
clips.sfx: drizzle, knees meeting wet concrete, a muffled sob

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Thương thì vẫn còn thương, nhưng giờ mình đã học được cách thương lấy chính mình rồi.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up beside the steaming pot, slow push-in
beats: The warm interior of the shop behind the counter, big pots steaming and banana leaves stacked on a shelf.
@Thu walks back from the counter to the steaming pot without looking back and speaks softly to herself, her eyes wet but steady and her lips clearly visible.
@Thu closes her mouth and lifts the lid of the big pot in a cloud of golden steam, her face calm as she gets back to work.
clips.sfx: pot lid lifting, a rush of steam, rice being stirred

scenes.title: Mẹ Vẫn Là Mẹ
scenes.time_label: Tối, gác nhỏ trên quán xôi (22:00–23:00)
scenes.location: Căn gác nhỏ phía trên quán xôi, nơi bà Nhàn ở cùng Thu và bé Na; cầu thang gỗ dẫn lên cửa.
scenes.axis: Cửa gỗ bên phải màn hình, bà Nhàn đứng trong cửa, Tùng đứng ở ngưỡng cửa phía ngoài; bàn thờ và cửa sổ bên trái.
scenes.props: Gậy tre chạm của bà Nhàn, bàn thờ nhỏ với nén nhang, đèn bàn vàng, cửa gỗ.
scenes.setting: Evening in a small cozy room above the sticky-rice shop: a low wooden bed, a family altar with incense, a window over the old-quarter street, a warm lamp.

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Mẹ ở ngay sau cánh cửa này, mà mình chẳng dám gõ, mẹ còn nhận đứa con bất hiếu này không?
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot from the top of the stairs, slow push-in
beats: A narrow wooden staircase climbing to a closed door, a thin strip of warm light glowing underneath it.
@Tung climbs the last steps, stops in front of the door and whispers to himself, his face half lit by the light under the door and his lips clearly visible.
@Tung closes his mouth and lifts one hand to knock, but it hovers just short of the wood and slowly drops back to his side.
clips.sfx: creaking wooden steps, a moped passing in the street below
clips.setting: Evening on a narrow wooden staircase leading up to a closed door above the sticky-rice shop, warm light under the door.

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Mày đến đây làm gì? Mẹ già rồi, không còn gì cho mày lấy nữa đâu con.
clips.camera: 35mm wide shot from inside the room toward the door, slow push-in
beats: The cozy room above the shop lit by a warm lamp, incense smoke curling from the small family altar beside the window.
@BaNhan opens the door leaning on her carved bamboo walking stick, finds @Tung on the threshold and speaks to him with a hard, tired face.
@BaNhan keeps one hand on the door frame, blocking the way in, while @Tung stands with his head lowered on the threshold.
clips.sfx: the door creaking open, a walking stick tapping the floor, faint street noise

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Mẹ ơi, con không lấy gì nữa, con chỉ xin mẹ cho con được làm người tử tế lại.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on Tùng, slow push-in
beats: @Tung lifts his red-rimmed eyes to @BaNhan from the threshold, his hands empty and open at his sides.
@Tung speaks to his mother in a low, breaking voice, his chin trembling.
@Tung falls quiet and bows his head deeply, waiting, the warm lamplight catching the stubble on his jaw.
clips.sfx: the lamp humming softly, a moped passing below

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Tử tế thì phải làm cả đời, mai con ra quán rửa bát, làm thuê cho con Thu đi.
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot, static
beats: @BaNhan studies @Tung's bowed head for a long moment, both hands folded on top of her bamboo walking stick.
@BaNhan speaks firmly and slowly to @Tung, tapping the stick once on the floor at the end of her words.
@Tung nods without lifting his head as @BaNhan presses her lips into a thin, trembling line.
clips.sfx: the stick tapping on wood, the lamp's soft hum, a quiet street below

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Vâng, con nghe mẹ, bao nhiêu năm con cãi mẹ rồi, từ nay mẹ bảo gì con cũng làm.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on Tùng, slow tilt down
beats: @Tung lifts his wet eyes to @BaNhan on the threshold and answers her in a low, steady voice, his chin trembling and his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung finishes speaking and closes his mouth, then bows his head very low before his mother, his eyes closing.
A single tear slides down @Tung's stubbled cheek and drops onto the worn floorboards as he stays bowed in the warm lamplight.
clips.sfx: a deep unsteady breath, the lamp hum, silence

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Nó dại thì nó chịu, nhưng dù sao nó vẫn là đứa con mình mang nặng đẻ đau.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot inside the room, slow push-in
beats: Inside the cozy room, the small family altar glows with incense beside the window over the lit old-quarter street.
@BaNhan closes the wooden door slowly, leans her back against it with both hands on her bamboo walking stick and murmurs to herself, her lips clearly visible.
@BaNhan closes her mouth, lifts the cuff of her brown knitted cardigan and dabs her eyes, her wrinkled face softening in the warm lamplight.
clips.sfx: the door latch clicking, a soft sniff, incense crackling

scenes.title: Buổi Diễn Văn Nghệ
scenes.time_label: Chiều, hội trường trường tiểu học (23:00–24:00)
scenes.location: Hội trường trường tiểu học của bé Na, buổi diễn văn nghệ cuối năm; góc hậu trường sau buổi diễn.
scenes.axis: Sân khấu ở cuối hình, hàng ghế phụ huynh phía trước; Thu và Tùng ở hàng ghế cuối bên phải; hậu trường: cửa ra vào bên trái.
scenes.props: Trống con màu đỏ và dùi trống của Na, hoa giấy, dây cờ màu, ghế nhựa.
scenes.setting: Afternoon in a primary school hall: a small stage with paper flower decorations and colorful bunting, rows of plastic chairs filled with parents.

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Hội trường chật kín phụ huynh thế này, vậy mà chín năm nay mình chưa đến xem con lần nào.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot from the back of the hall, slow crane down
beats: Colorful bunting and paper flowers strung high across a bright primary school hall in the afternoon, the small decorated stage glowing at the far end.
@Tung steps into the aisle at the back of the hall behind rows of parents in plastic chairs and murmurs to himself, his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung closes his mouth and stands still with his eyes glistening, gazing over the rows of parents toward the stage.
clips.sfx: scattered applause, chairs scraping, a small drum tapping offstage
clips.extras: rows of parents seen from behind in plastic chairs

clips.speaker: @Na
clips.line: Bố có đến không nhỉ? Mẹ bảo hôm nay bố đến mà, sao con tìm mãi chẳng thấy đâu?
clips.camera: 85mm close-up from the foot of the stage, slow tracking
beats: The small stage framed with paper flowers and colorful bunting, warm afternoon light falling across its empty wooden boards.
@Na marches to the front edge of the stage beating a small red drum, pauses and whispers to herself while scanning the rows of parents below, her lips clearly visible.
@Na closes her mouth and starts drumming again, her eyes still searching the rows of chairs.
clips.sfx: a small drum beating a steady march, scattered applause

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Con bé tìm anh suốt từ nãy đấy, anh giơ tay vẫy đi cho con nhìn thấy bố.
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot from the side, slow push-in
beats: The last row of plastic chairs at the back of the hall, warm light from the high windows falling across empty seats.
@Tung sits stiffly beside @Thu in the last row as @Thu speaks softly to him with her eyes on the stage, her hands folded in her lap and her lips clearly visible.
@Thu closes her mouth with a quiet smile as @Tung lifts one hand and waves toward the stage, his eyes glistening.
clips.sfx: the little drum from the stage, applause swelling

clips.speaker: @Na
clips.line: Bố đến thật rồi! Bố ơi, lần sau bố đến sớm hơn để ngồi hàng đầu nhé.
clips.camera: 35mm wide two-shot, slow push-in
beats: A quiet backstage corner of the school hall, paper flowers and folded bunting piled on a chair in soft afternoon light.
@Na runs into frame with her small red drum and stops in front of @Tung, looking up at him and speaking breathlessly.
@Na beams up at @Tung, still holding her drumsticks, while he stands before her with his hands at his sides.
clips.sfx: distant applause from the hall, quick small footsteps, the drum bumping against her hip
clips.setting: Backstage corner of the school hall after the show, paper decorations, soft afternoon light.

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Bố hứa, từ nay buổi diễn nào của con, bố cũng đến sớm nhất, ngồi hàng đầu tiên.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot from child height, slow push-in
beats: @Tung kneels down to @Na's eye level on the backstage floor, his creased suit trousers touching the boards.
@Tung speaks softly and earnestly to @Na, holding up his little finger toward her.
@Na hooks her little finger around @Tung's and they hold the pinky promise between them, both smiling.
clips.sfx: faint applause from the hall, paper decorations rustling
clips.setting: Backstage corner of the school hall after the show, paper decorations, soft afternoon light.

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Mình tha thứ không phải để quay lại với anh ấy, mà để con mình còn có bố.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on Thu in the doorway, slow push-in
beats: A doorway at the edge of the backstage corner, soft afternoon light and a string of paper flowers hanging across it.
@Thu steps into the doorway with her hands folded in front of her, watching quietly, and murmurs to herself, her lips clearly visible.
@Thu closes her mouth, her eyes shining, and a small smile settles on her face as she lets out a long, quiet breath.
clips.sfx: soft applause fading, a breeze through the paper flowers
clips.setting: Backstage corner of the school hall after the show, paper decorations, soft afternoon light.

scenes.title: Vợ Tào Khang
scenes.location: Quán xôi của Thu ở phố cổ, một năm sau, sáng sớm nắng vàng đầu tiên; cuối cảnh là toàn cảnh mái phố cổ từ trên cao.
scenes.axis: Quầy gỗ và nồi xôi bên trái, góc rửa bát của Tùng ở phía sau bên phải; phố ở phía trước máy quay.
scenes.props: Nồi xôi lớn bốc khói, chồng bát, chậu rửa, gói xôi lá chuối, ghế đẩu.
scenes.setting: Before dawn at Thu's small sticky-rice shop on a Hà Nội old-quarter street: a worn wooden counter, rows of banana-leaf parcels, big steaming pots, warm yellow light spilling onto the pavement.

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Mới một năm đã ba cửa hàng, sao con còn tự tay đồ mẻ xôi đầu cho mệt hả con?
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot from the street, slow push-in to the doorway
beats: The old-quarter street at first light, the sticky-rice shop's warm light spilling across the pavement and thick steam billowing from a row of big pots behind the worn wooden counter.
@Thu lifts a steamer lid behind the counter as @BaNhan steps up beside it with her bamboo walking stick and speaks fondly to her, her lips clearly visible.
@BaNhan closes her mouth and shakes her head with a smile while @Thu turns the rice, the first gold light of sunrise touching the rooftops above the shop.
clips.sfx: steam roaring, birds waking, a walking stick tapping the floor

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Mẻ đầu là mẻ của nhà mình mẹ ạ, tay con vẫn chai, nhưng lòng con giờ nhẹ lắm.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on Thu at the steamer, slow arc
beats: @Thu turns the glossy sticky rice with a wooden paddle and answers @BaNhan with a calm smile, her rough hands moving with easy confidence and her lips clearly visible.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, then straightens and looks out at the street through the rising steam, her eyes bright.
@Thu's calm face glows in the golden steam of the first sunlight while @BaNhan nods softly at the edge of the frame.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, the wooden paddle scraping, sparrows chirping

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Làm thuê cho vợ cũ cũng được, mỗi cái bát rửa sạch là trả bớt một chút nợ ân tình.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot in the back corner, slow push-in
beats: A corner at the back of the shop, a big plastic basin of soapy water and a tall stack of bowls on a low stool.
@Tung sits on a low stool with his shirt sleeves rolled up, washing a bowl in the soapy basin and murmuring to himself, his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung closes his mouth, sets the clean bowl on the stack and glances toward the front of the shop with a quiet, humble look.
clips.sfx: water sloshing, bowls clinking, steam in the background

clips.speaker: @Na
clips.line: Mẹ ơi, sau này lớn lên con muốn giỏi giang như mẹ, không cần dựa vào ai cả.
clips.camera: 35mm wide two-shot by the counter, slow push-in
beats: The front counter of the shop in golden morning light, a small stack of banana-leaf parcels and bamboo strings beside a steaming pot.
@Na in her school uniform hops onto a stool beside @Thu at the counter and looks up at her mother, speaking earnestly.
@Na rests her chin on her hands on the counter, gazing up at @Thu, as @Thu turns toward her with a soft smile.
clips.sfx: morning street sounds, steam, a stool scraping

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Con cứ sống tử tế, chăm chỉ, ai bỏ con mà đi thì người thiệt là họ, không phải con.
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot, slow push-in
beats: @Thu wipes her hands on her dark-green apron and tucks a loose strand of hair behind @Na's ear.
@Thu speaks gently and firmly to @Na, her eyes steady on her daughter's face.
@Na nods hard and @Thu hands her a warm banana-leaf parcel for school, both of them smiling in the golden light.
clips.sfx: steam, a banana leaf crinkling, birds outside

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Người ta có thể đi tìm hương lạ, nhưng vợ tào khang thì cả đời chỉ có một thôi con ạ.
clips.camera: 24mm low aerial drone shot, slow rising pull-back from the shop doorway over the rooftops
beats: Low aerial view of a small corner shop in Hà Nội's old quarter at sunrise, a column of white steam rising from its empty golden doorway.
@Thu steps into the doorway holding @Na's hand, the camera still low in front of them, and speaks softly to @Na while looking out at the sunrise, her face and lips clearly visible.
@Thu closes her mouth and smiles as the camera rises over a sea of mossy tiled roofs, mother and daughter small in the glowing doorway beneath a wide golden sky.
clips.sfx: a soft morning wind, distant temple bells, the city waking
clips.setting: Sunrise over the tiled roofs of Hà Nội's old quarter seen from a low drone: golden light, steam rising from the open doorway of a small sticky-rice shop on a corner street.
